title: Elon Musk’s SpaceX reports losses but less than expected
english: SpaceX recently announced a quarterly loss of over $500 million, which was significantly lower than what financial experts had predicted. Despite the loss, the company experienced a massive 90 percent surge in revenue, reaching $7.8 billion, driven largely by its Starlink satellite internet services and major government contracts. Elon Musk's company is currently investing heavily in expanding its satellite infrastructure and AI technology, including the upcoming launch of new AI-capable satellites.
amharic: ስፔስ ኤክስ በቅርቡ ባወጣው የሩብ ዓመት ሪፖርት ከ500 ሚሊዮን ዶላር በላይ ኪሳራ እንዳጋጠመው አስታውቋል፤ ሆኖም ይህ መጠን የገበያ ተንታኞች ከጠበቁት በታች ነው። ኪሳራው ቢኖርም የኩባንያው ገቢ ከባለፈው ዓመት ጋር ሲነጻጸር በ90 በመቶ በማደግ 7.8 ቢሊዮን ዶላር ደርሷል፤ ይህም በዋናነት በስታርሊንክ የኢንተርኔት አገልግሎት እና በመንግስት ውሎች የተገኘ ነው። ኤሎን ማስክ የኩባንያውን የሳተላይት መሠረተ ልማት እና አርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ ቴክኖሎጂን ለማስፋፋት ከፍተኛ ኢንቨስትመንት እያደረገ ይገኛል።
oromo: SpaceX gabaasa baatiiwwan sadan darban keessatti kan baaseen, kisaaraan isaa gara biliyoona walakkaa ol ta'us, kun garuu tilmaama ogeeyyiin gabaa kennanii gadi ta'uu beeksiseera. Kisaaraa kana keessa iyyuu, galii kampaanichaa dhibbeentaa 90 ol dabaluun gara biliyoona 7.8 ga'eera; kunis tajaajila internetii Starlink fi waliigaltee mootummaa irraa kan argame dha. Kampaanichi kan Elon Musk, bu'uuraalee misoomaa hawaa fi teeknoolojii 'artificial intelligence' babal'isuuf qarshii guddaa baasaa jira.

title: How the far right weaponised the Ceuta crisis
english: A tragic incident involving the deaths of over 70 migrants attempting to reach Ceuta quickly transformed into a major political controversy. Far-right groups exploited the humanitarian disaster to advance their own agendas, sparking intense debate in Spain. Analysts warn that the political fallout from this crisis may have significant and long-lasting consequences far beyond Spanish borders.
amharic: ወደ ሴኡታ ለመድረስ ሲሞክሩ ከ72 በላይ ስደተኞች ህይወታቸው ያለፈበት አሳዛኝ ክስተት በፍጥነት ወደ ትልቅ የፖለቲካ ውዝግብ ተቀይሯል። የቀኝ አክራሪ ቡድኖች ይህንን ሰብአዊ ቀውስ የራሳቸውን የፖለቲካ አጀንዳ ለማራመድ ተጠቅመውበታል፣ ይህም በስፔን ውስጥ ከፍተኛ ክርክር አስነስቷል። ተንታኞች እንደሚጠቁሙት ከዚህ ቀውስ የሚመነጨው የፖለቲካ መዘዝ ከስፔን ድንበር አልፎ በሌሎች አካባቢዎችም የረጅም ጊዜ ተጽእኖ ሊኖረው ይችላል።
oromo: Godaanonni 72 ol ta’an gara Se'utaatti ce'uuf yaalii godhan irratti lubbuun isaanii darbuun isaa, yeruma sana gara jeequumsa siyaasaatti jijjiirameera. Gareewwan mirga-fayyotaa (far-right) balaa namoomaa kana gara faayidaa siyaasaa mataa isaanii oolchuun, biyya Ispeen keessatti falmii cimaa kaaseera. Ogeeyyonni akka ibsanitti, rakkoon siyaasaa mudate kun daangaa Ispeen darbee dhiibbaa gara fuulduraa gurguddaa qabaachuu danda'a.

title: Funeral for family killed in US strike on Iran’s Qeshm Island
english: A funeral has taken place for a couple and their young child who were killed during a recent United States military strike on Iran's Qeshm Island. Following the tragedy, senior Iranian official Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf condemned the action and warned that the U.S. would face consequences for the attack. The event has further strained tensions in the region.
amharic: በኢራን ቃሽም ደሴት በአሜሪካ በተፈጸመ የአየር ጥቃት ህይወታቸው ያለፈ ቤተሰቦች የቀብር ስነ-ስርዓት ተፈጽሟል። በጥቃቱ አንድ ጥንዶች እና የሁለት ዓመት ህጻን ልጃቸው መገደላቸውን ተከትሎ፣ የኢራን ከፍተኛ ባለስልጣን መሐመድ ባጌር ጋሊባፍ አሜሪካ ለዚህ ተግባሯ ዋጋ እንደምትከፍል አስጠንቅቀዋል። ክስተቱ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን ውጥረት አባብሶታል።
oromo: Maatii warra magaalaa Qeshm irratti weerara humna waraana Ameerikaatiin ajjeefaman du’aatiin isaanii sirnaan raawwatameera. Weerara kanaan abbaa manaa, haadha manaa fi ijoollee isaanii waggaa lamaa du’uu isaanii hordofee, itti gaafatamaan mootummaa Iraan Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, Ameerikaan tarkaanfii fudhatteef gatii akka kaffaltu akeekkachiisaniiru. Gochi kun walitti bu’iinsa biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiru daran hammaachiseera.

title: Death toll rises to 87 in India’s flood-stricken Assam
english: Severe monsoon flooding in India's Assam region has resulted in 87 deaths. Many residents have been displaced, forced to live in temporary shelters while their homes and agricultural lands remain underwater. Villagers are currently relying on makeshift rafts to salvage their personal belongings from the flooded areas.
amharic: በህንድ የአሳም ክልል በደረሰው ከባድ የዝናብ ጎርፍ የሟቾች ቁጥር 87 ደርሷል። ብዙ ነዋሪዎች ቤታቸው እና እርሻቸው በውሃ በመጥለቅለቁ ምክንያት ተፈናቅለው በጊዜያዊ መጠለያዎች ለመኖር ተገደዋል። የገጠር ነዋሪዎችም ንብረቶቻቸውን ለማዳን በራሳቸው የተሰሩ ታንኳዎችን እየተጠቀሙ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Godina Assaam kan biyya Indiyaa keessatti roobni cimaan waan roobeef lolaan mudate lubbuu namoota 87 galaafateera. Namoonni baay'een manneen isaanii fi lafti qonnaa bishaanin guutamee waan jiruuf, iddoo bultii yeroo keessa jiraachuuf dirqamaniiru. Jiraattoonni naannichaa qabeenya isaanii bishaan keessaa baafachuuf meeshaa bishaan irra deeman gargaaramuuf dirqamaniiru.

title: Six years on, Beirut blast families still await justice
english: Families of those killed in the 2020 Beirut port explosion gathered to mark the six-year anniversary of the tragedy. They continue to call for government accountability and the completion of the long-delayed legal investigation. Many relatives expressed frustration and ongoing pain, as they still have not received the truth or justice they deserve.
amharic: የቤይሩት ወደብ ፍንዳታ ሰለባዎች ቤተሰቦች የአደጋውን ስድስተኛ ዓመት በሀዘን አስታውሰዋል። ተጎጂዎቹ መንግስት ለደረሰው ጥፋት ተጠያቂ እንዲያደርግ እና ለረጅም ጊዜ የዘገየውን የፍትህ ሂደት እንዲያፋጥን ጠይቀዋል። ፍትህ አለማግኘታቸው የቤተሰቦቹን ሀዘን እና ብስጭት እንደሚያባብስ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Maatiin namoota dhukaatee buufata doonii Bayirut waggaa ja’a dura mudateen lubbuunsaanii darbe, yeroo yaadatamaa jiru kana gaaffii haqaa dhiyeessaa jiru. Hawaasni kun qaamolee itti gaafatamummaa qaban seeratti akka dhihaatanifi qorannoon seeraa yeroodhaan akka xumuramu gaafataniiru. Haqni hanga yoonaatti argachuu dhabuunsaanii gaddaafi aarii maatiiwwan kanaa itti fufee akka jiru hubatameera.

title: National Guard deployment to Washington, DC will cost US roughly $1.4bn
english: The U.S. Defense Department estimates that keeping National Guard troops in Washington, D.C. through January 2029 will cost approximately $1.4 billion. About 2,500 soldiers are expected to remain stationed in the capital to carry out tasks like patrolling and assisting with city operations. This decision has faced significant pushback from local leaders and some lawmakers, who view the ongoing presence as an expensive and unnecessary militarization of the city.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መከላከያ ሚኒስቴር ብሄራዊ ጥበቃ ሰራዊትን እስከ ጥር 2029 ድረስ በዋሽንግተን ዲሲ የማቆየት ወጪ 1.4 ቢሊዮን ዶላር እንደሚደርስ ገልጿል። በከተማዋ ለሚደረጉ የፀጥታና የድጋፍ ስራዎች በየጊዜው 2,500 የሚሆኑ ወታደሮች እንደሚሰማሩ ይጠበቃል። ይህ ውሳኔ በከተማዋ ነዋሪዎችና በአንዳንድ የህግ አውጪዎች ዘንድ ከተማዋን ያለአግባብ በወታደራዊ ሃይል በማጥበብና ከፍተኛ የመንግስት ገንዘብ በማባከን ተችቷል።
oromo: Ministeerri ittisa biyyaa Ameerikaa humnoonni ittisa biyyaa (National Guard) hanga Amajjii bara 2029tti magaala guddoo Washington D.C. keessatti turuun isaanii qarshii biliyoona 1.4 akka gaafatu ibseera. Humnoonni kun magaalaa keessatti nageenya eeguu fi tajaajila adda addaa kennuuf kan turan yoo ta'u, kunis mormii cimaa geggeessitoota magaalaa fi bakka bu'oota uummataa biraa mudateera. Mormitoonni kunneen turtiin waraanaa kun magaalaa irratti dhiibbaa uummachuu fi baasii mootummaa kan hin barbaachisne akka ta'e dubbatu.

title: US says deal on reopening Hormuz close as Iran, Oman hold ‘positive’ talks
english: The United States and Iran are nearing an agreement to secure safer shipping routes through the Strait of Hormuz, with Oman acting as a mediator for the talks. While both sides have characterized the discussions as positive, some technical and security disagreements regarding the waterway's operation remain. Officials from both countries suggest that a deal could be finalized very soon, which would help lower regional tensions.
amharic: አሜሪካ እና ኢራን በሆርሙዝ ባህር ላይ የንግድ መርከቦች በሰላም እንዲያልፉ የሚያስችል ስምምነት ላይ ለመድረስ መቃረባቸውን ገልጸዋል። ኦማን አደራዳሪ በመሆን በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ውይይቶችን እያመቻቸች ሲሆን፣ እስካሁን ባለው ሂደትም አወንታዊ ውጤቶች መታየታቸው ተነግሯል። ምንም እንኳን አንዳንድ የቴክኒክ እና የደህንነት ጉዳዮች ገና ያልተፈቱ ቢሆንም፣ ስምምነቱ በቅርብ ቀናት ውስጥ ሊጠናቀቅ እንደሚችል እምነት ተጥሏል።
oromo: Amerikaa fi Iraan daandii dooniiwwan karaa Hormuz darban amansiisaa gochuuf walii galtee irra gahuuf dhiyaataniiru; kana keessatti Omaan akka giddu-galeessatti tajaajilaa jirti. Mariin kun hanga ammaatti milkaa'ina qabaatus, rakkoowwan teeknikaa fi nageenyaa irratti waliigalteen xumuraa akka hin irra gahamne ibsameera. Haata'u malee, hoggantoonni biyyoota lamaanii guyyoota dhufan keessatti waliigalteen kun xumura argachuu akka danda'u abdii qabu.

title: US Centcom says Hormuz remains 'free and open'
english: The US Central Command has confirmed that the Strait of Hormuz continues to be accessible for international commercial shipping. Despite recent aggressive actions by Iran, American forces have safely guided over 1,000 ships through the waterway in the last three months. The U.S. maintains that this vital route stays open for all merchant vessels traveling through the area.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ማዕከላዊ ዕዝ የሆርሙዝ ባህር ሰላጤ ለንግድ መርከቦች ክፍት ሆኖ መቀጠሉን አረጋግጧል። ኢራን በቅርቡ ባሳየችው የጠብ አጫሪነት ድርጊቶች ቢሆንም፣ የአሜሪካ ኃይሎች ባለፉት ሶስት ወራት ውስጥ ከ1,000 በላይ መርከቦች በሰላም እንዲያልፉ ረድተዋል። ይህ ዓለም አቀፍ የውሃ መስመር ለሁሉም የንግድ መርከቦች ነፃ እና ክፍት መሆኑን አሜሪካ በይፋ አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Ajajni giddu galaa kan Ameerikaa (Centcom) handhuurri Hormuz daldala idil-addunyaaf banaa ta'uu isaa mirkaneesseera. Iran gochaan weeraraa ta'e raawwattuus, waraanni Ameerikaa ji'oota sadan darban keessa markaboota 1,000 ol ta'an nagaan akka darbanii darban gargaareera. Karaan bishaanii kun markaboota daldalaa hundaaf yeroo ammaa banaa fi bilisa akka ta'e ibsameera.

title: Israeli military sets off 'huge explosion' in southern Lebanon’s Haddatha
english: Israeli forces conducted a major explosion in the southern Lebanese town of Haddatha today. This military action coincides with the start of diplomatic negotiations in Rome focused on securing an Israeli withdrawal and the disarmament of Hezbollah. The talks aim to establish a framework for peace in the region.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በደቡብ ሊባኖስ ሀዳታ ከተማ ውስጥ ትልቅ ፍንዳታ አድርሰዋል። ይህ ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ የተካሄደው እስራኤል ከደቡብ ሊባኖስ የምትወጣበትን እና ሂዝቦላህ ትጥቅ የሚፈታበትን ስምምነት ለመፍጠር በሮም እየተካሄደ ካለው ድርድር ጋር በተያያዘ ነው። ንግግሮቹ በክልሉ ዘላቂ ሰላም ለማምጣት ያለሙ ናቸው።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'eel magaalaa Haddatha jedhamtu kan Kibba Liibaanoositti argamtu keessatti dhukaasa guddaa raawwateera. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame yeroo mariin nageenyaa waraanni Israa'eel naannichaa akka gadhiisu fi Heezbullaahn akka hidhannoo hiiku irratti xiyyeeffate Roomaatti eegalamee jiruudha. Mariin kun naannichatti nagaa buusuuf gargaara jedhamee eeggama.

title: Saudi Aramco reports bumper profits as it bypasses Strait of Hormuz
english: Saudi Aramco experienced a 33 percent profit increase in the second quarter, reaching $33.4 billion due to rising global energy prices. The conflict between the U.S. and Iran has caused oil prices to surge while disrupting regional shipments. Aramco successfully maintained its exports by utilizing pipelines that avoid the volatile Strait of Hormuz.
amharic: ሳዑዲ አራምኮ በሁለተኛው ሩብ ዓመት የትርፍ መጠኑ በ33 በመቶ አድጎ 33.4 ቢሊዮን ዶላር መድረሱን አስታውቋል። በአሜሪካ እና በአሜሪካ መካከል ያለው ግጭት የነዳጅ ዋጋ እንዲንር ያደረገ ሲሆን፣ የክልሉን የነዳጅ ማጓጓዣ ስራዎችም አግዷል። የሳዑዲ ኩባንያው በአለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ውጥረት የበዛበትን የሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ በማለፍ በቧንቧ መስመሮች አማካኝነት ዘይት መላኩ ለዚህ ስኬት ዋነኛው ምክንያት ሆኗል።
oromo: Kampaniin Saudi Aramco bu'aan isaa marsaa lammaffaa keessatti dhibbeentaa 33 ol guddatee gara biliyoona 33.4 ga'eera. Walitti bu'iinsi gidduu Ameerikaafi Iraan jiru gatii boba'aa addunyaa irratti dabaluun, ergaa boba'aa naannichaa irratti danqaa uumeera. Aramco naannoo galaana Hormuz kan waraanni itti baay'ate karaa bo'oo boba'aa dhiisuun, gabaa isaa tasgabbeeffatee itti fufeera.

title: 'Collective punishment': US Supreme Court greenlights $656m judgement against Palestinian officials
english: The U.S. Supreme Court has allowed a $656 million legal judgment against the Palestinian Authority and the PLO to move forward, rejecting their claims of financial inability to pay. This ruling follows a long-standing lawsuit involving victims of violence that occurred during the Second Intifada in Israel. The decision effectively permits the immediate collection of these funds, concluding a legal battle that has lasted over two decades.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት የፍልስጤም አስተዳደር እና የፍልስጤም ነጻ አውጪ ድርጅት (PLO) መክፈል ያለባቸውን 656 ሚሊዮን ዶላር የካሳ ውሳኔ አጽድቋል። ተቋማቱ ገንዘቡን የመክፈል አቅም እንደሌላቸው ቢገልጹም ፍርድ ቤቱ ግን ውሳኔውን ውድቅ አድርጎታል። ይህ ውሳኔ በሁለተኛው የፍልስጤም ኢንቲፋዳ ወቅት ለተጎዱ ወገኖች የሚከፈል ሲሆን፣ ከ22 ዓመታት በላይ የዘለቀውን የፍርድ ሂደት ወደ ፍጻሜ ያደርሳል።
oromo: Mana murtii olaanaa Amerikaa, mootummaan Falasxiinii fi dhaabbanni bilisa baasaa Falasxiinii (PLO) kaffaltii beenyaa $656 miliyoonaa akka raawwatan murteesse. Dhaabbanni kunneen kaffaltii kana raawwachuuf humna akka hin qabne ibsataniyyu, mana murtiichatti garuu kaffaltiin sun akka raawwatamu ajajeera. Murteen kun waraana 'Second Intifada' jedhamu keessatti namoota miidhamanif kan kennamu yoo ta'u, dhimmi kun waggoota 22 oliif seeraan osoo wal falmisiisuu booda amma xumura argateera.

title: Saudi Aramco reports bumper profits as it bypasses Strait of Hormuz
english: Saudi Aramco experienced a 33 percent increase in second-quarter profits, reaching $33.4 billion, largely driven by high energy prices caused by the conflict between the US and Iran. The company successfully maintained its export levels by utilizing the East-West Pipeline, which allows oil to be transported to the Red Sea while avoiding the volatile Strait of Hormuz. Because of these disruptions, other regional nations are now investing heavily in new infrastructure projects to bypass the strait and secure their future energy shipments.
amharic: ሳውዲ አራምኮ በዩኤስ እና በኢራን መካከል ባለው ግጭት ምክንያት በተፈጠረው የነዳጅ ዋጋ ጭማሪ ተጠቅማ በሁለተኛው ሩብ ዓመት ትርፏን በ33 በመቶ ማሳደግ ችላለች። ኩባንያው የምስራቅ-ምዕራብ የነዳጅ መስመርን በመጠቀም የሆርሙዝን የባህር ወሽመጥ በማለፍ ነዳጅ መላኩን ቀጥሏል። በዚህ ቀውስ ምክንያት ሌሎች የክልሉ ሀገራት የወደፊት የነዳጅ ማጓጓዣ ደህንነታቸውን ለመጠበቅ በሆርሙዝ ማለፊያ ምትክ አዳዲስ የመሠረተ ልማት ግንባታዎችን እያከናወኑ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Saudi Aramco bu'aa ishee kan kuta lammaffaa keessatti dhibbeentaa 33 dabaluun gara biliyoona 33.4tti guddifatteetti; kunis gurgurtaa boba'aa irratti gatiin dabaluun kan dhufe yoo ta'u, sababni isaas waraana US fi Iran gidduutti jiruudha. Kompaniin kun daandii boba'aa 'East-West Pipeline' fayyadamuun, bakka waraanni itti baay'ate kan 'Strait of Hormuz' irraa fagaachuun gabaa isaa itti fufuu danda'eera. Rakkoo kana booda, biyyoonni naannichaa biroo gara fuulduraatti boba'aa isaanii nageenyaan ergachuuf, daandiiwwan biraa ijaaruuf qophii guddaa godhaa jiru.

title: Arrests in Egypt after people allegedly impersonate judges
english: Egyptian authorities have arrested several individuals, including an unemployed man and a student, for running a scam where they posed as judges to steal money. The group staged fake courtroom scenes and used social media to trick victims into believing they could help secure government housing. Police uncovered the plot after a victim reported the fraud, leading to the seizure of fake judicial identification and the arrest of both the scammers and complicit court staff.

oromo: Mootummaan Masri namoota gurguddoo ta'an kanneen akka abbaa seeraatti of fakkeessanii maallaqa namootaa hatu turan to'annoo jala oolche. Gareen kun mana murtii sobaa qopheessuudhaan fi miidiyaalee hawaasaatti fayyadamuudhaan, manoota mootummaa argamsiisuuf waadaa seenuudhaan namoota gowwoomsu turan. Poolisiin qorannoo geggeessuun namoota kana to'annoo jala oolcheera, akkasumas namoota hojjettoota mana murtii ta'an kanneen gargaarsa isaanii ta'anis qabuu danda'eera.

title: Evacuations ordered as Guatemala volcano erupts
english: Guatemala's Fuego volcano began a significant eruption on Monday, leading officials to issue a national orange alert. Authorities have ordered the immediate evacuation of two communities located near the site to ensure public safety. These preventative actions were taken due to lessons learned from a devastating volcanic event in 2018.
amharic: የጓቲማላው የፉዌጎ እሳተ ገሞራ በሰኞ ዕለት መፈንዳቱን ተከትሎ አገሪቱ ብሔራዊ ብርቱካናማ ማስጠንቀቂያ አውጃለች። ለህዝብ ደህንነት ሲባል በእሳተ ገሞራው አቅራቢያ የሚገኙ ሁለት መንደሮች ነዋሪዎች አስቸኳይ ለቀቅ እንዲያደርጉ ታዘዋል። ይህ ጥንቃቄ የተሞላበት እርምጃ በ2018 ከደረሰው አሰቃቂ ፍንዳታ የተገኘውን ትምህርት መሰረት በማድረግ የተወሰደ ነው።
oromo: Tulluun ibidda gurguddaa Fuego jedhamu kan Gwatamaala keessatti argamu Dilbata darbe dhoohuun isaa beekameera. Kana hordofee mootummaan biyyattii akeekkachiisa hatattamaa kan 'orange alert' jedhamu labseera. Namoonni naannoo sana jiraatan balaa irraa ooluuf iddoo nageenya qabutti akka godaanan ajajameera; tarkaanfiin kunis kan fudhatame balaa bara 2018 dhufe irraa barachuun of eeggannoo gochuufi.

title: Red Cross urges international aid as Sudan crisis deepens
english: The International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies is calling for increased global aid as the humanitarian crisis in Sudan worsens after more than three years of conflict. Millions of people are facing severe shortages of food, water, and healthcare, while the violence continues to displace large portions of the population. Although the Sudanese military claims to be making progress in its fight against paramilitary forces, the urgent need for international financial and humanitarian support remains critical.
amharic: የዓለም አቀፉ የቀይ መስቀልና የቀይ ጨረቃ ማህበራት ፌዴሬሽን በሱዳን ከሶስት ዓመታት በላይ በዘለቀው ግጭት ሳቢያ የተፈጠረው የሰብአዊ ቀውስ እየተባባሰ በመምጣቱ ዓለም አቀፍ ድጋፍ እንዲደረግ ጥሪ አቅርቧል። በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ ዜጎች የምግብ፣ የንፁህ መጠጥ ውሃ እና የህክምና አገልግሎት እጥረት ገጥሟቸዋል፤ ግጭቱም በርካታ ሰዎችን ከቀያቸው አፈናቅሏል። የሱዳን ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በከፊል ወታደራዊ ቡድኑ ላይ ድል እየተቀዳጁ መሆናቸውን ቢናገሩም፣ ለተጎጂዎች የሚደረገው ዓለም አቀፍ የገንዘብ እና የሰብአዊ ድጋፍ አሁንም በጣም አነስተኛ ነው።
oromo: Federeeshiniin Xalayaa Diimaa fi Ji'a Diimaa idil-addunyaa, waraana Sudaan keessatti waggoota sadii ol tureef hammaataa dhufuun wal-qabatee gargaarsa idil-addunyaa akka barbaachisu ibseera. Namoonni miiliyoonaan lakkaawaman nyaata, bishaan qulqulluu fi tajaajila fayyaa dhabuun rakkoo guddaa keessa kan jiran yoo ta'u, waraanichi uummata hedduu qe'ee isaanii irraa buqqiseera. Humnoonni waraana Sudaan mormitoota isaanii irratti tarkaanfii fudhachaa jiraachuu ibsatanis, gargaarsi maallaqaa fi namoomaa idil-addunyaan gahu ammas baay'ee xiqqaa dha.

title: Telegram says Apple suspension followed content norms violation by one user
english: Apple briefly removed the Telegram messaging app from its store after discovering that a single user had shared illegal content related to child sexual abuse. Telegram responded by removing the harmful material and banning the account responsible, leading to the app's prompt restoration. This situation highlights ongoing debates regarding the responsibility of major communication platforms to monitor and manage illegal user activity.
amharic: አፕል የቴሌግራም መተግበሪያን ከስታንዲያዊው የመተግበሪያ መደብር ለአጭር ጊዜ ያገደው አንድ ተጠቃሚ ህገ-ወጥ የህጻናት የወሲብ ይዘት በማጋራቱ ምክንያት ነው። ቴሌግራም ችግር ያለበትን ይዘት በማስወገድ እና ተጠቃሚውን በመከልከል መተግበሪያው እንደገና እንዲሰራ አድርጓል። ይህ ክስተት የመገናኛ መድረኮች ህገ-ወጥ ድርጊቶችን በመቆጣጠር ረገድ ስላላቸው ኃላፊነት የቴክኖሎጂ ኩባንያዎች መካከል ያለውን ውዝግብ አሳይቷል።
oromo: Apple appii Telegeraamii store isaa irraa yeroo gabaabaaf kan dhaabe, fayyadamtoota isaa keessaa tokko qabiyyee seeraan alaa kan daa'imman irratti raawwatamu qooduu isaatiin hordofee dha. Telegeraam qabiyyee miidhaa geessisu san haquu fi fayyadamaa sana daangessuun appichi akka deebi'ee hojjetu godheera. Haalli kun sirnoota wal-qunnamtii gurguddoon dalagaa seeraan alaa to'achuu irratti gahee qaban ilaalchisee falmii uumeera.

title: Kazakhstan releases first tiger to restore extinct species
english: Kazakhstan has reintroduced an Amur tiger into the wild, marking the first time the species has been seen in the country in over seven decades. This effort is part of an official agreement between Kazakhstan and Russia to bring the tiger population back to Central Asia. The initiative aims to successfully restore the Caspian tiger, which had previously gone extinct in the region.

Kaayyoon isaas qeerransa gosa 'Caspian' jedhamuu fi naannichatti dhabamee ture deebisanii horachuufi.

title: White House to meet AI firms on advanced model safety
english: The White House is convening with leading artificial intelligence firms to address urgent safety concerns following recent security breaches involving OpenAI and Anthropic models. The discussion focuses on a government proposal that would allow federal authorities to test advanced AI systems for up to 30 days before they are released to the public. These meetings follow growing alarms from state officials and tech leaders regarding the potential for AI to operate outside of human control.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ዋይት ሀውስ በቅርቡ በኦፕን ኤአይ (OpenAI) እና በአንትሮፒክ (Anthropic) የቴክኖሎጂ ሞዴሎች ላይ የታዩትን የደህንነት ጥሰቶች ተከትሎ ከዘርፉ ዋና ዋና ኩባንያዎች ጋር ለመወያየት ቀጠሮ ይዟል። ውይይቱ የፌዴራል መንግስት አዳዲስ እና ከፍተኛ አቅም ያላቸውን የሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት (AI) ስልቶች ለህዝብ ከመለቀቃቸው በፊት ለ30 ቀናት ያህል እንዲመረምሩ የሚያስችል ደንብ ላይ ያተኩራል። ይህ ስብሰባ የተዘጋጀው ቴክኖሎጂው ከሰው ቁጥጥር ውጪ የመውጣቱ ስጋት እየጨመረ በመምጣቱ ነው።
oromo: Mana maree Ameerikaa (White House) dhimma nageenyaa fi rakkoolee nageenyaa teeknolojiiwwan AI gurguddoo irratti mul'atan irratti fiirummaa qaban wajjin mari’achuuf qophaa’eera. Mariin kun mootummaan federaalaa sirna AI ammayyaawaa ta’an gabaatti ba’uun isaanii dura guyyoota 30f akka qoratu hayyamuuf kan xiyyeeffatu dha. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame booda keessa teeknolojiiwwan kunniin to’annoo namaa jalaa bahuun isaa fi miidhaan inni qaqqabsiisuu danda’u yaaddoo uumeera.

title: Why did the US economy slow down?
english: The United States economy has experienced a slower growth rate than experts initially anticipated. This decline is not due to a reduction in consumer spending, but rather relates to how economic growth is calculated. Furthermore, significant national investments in artificial intelligence have played a notable role in this recent economic shift.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ኢኮኖሚ ከጠበቁት በታች በሆነ ፍጥነት እያደገ ይገኛል። ይህ መቀዛቀዝ የህዝቡን የወጪ ንግድ ቅነሳ ያላመላከተ ሲሆን፣ በዋናነት የተከሰተው ኢኮኖሚያዊ ዕድገት በሚሰላበት መንገድ እና በሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት (AI) ቴክኖሎጂ ላይ በተደረገው ከፍተኛ ኢንቨስትመንት ምክንያት ነው።
oromo: Dinagdeen biyya Ameerikaa akka yaadamee ol saffisaan guddachuu dhabeera. Hir'inni kun kan uumame gabaarratti hirmaannaan uummataa waan hir'ateef miti; kanarratti jijjiirama mudate kanneen akka mala herrega guddina dinagdee fi invastimantii gurguddaa teeknoolojii 'artificial intelligence' irratti taasifame dha.

title: Israel election pressure fuels settlement push as West Bank violence surges
english: As Israel approaches its October elections, there has been a significant rise in illegal settlement activities and violence in the West Bank. Right-wing politicians are aggressively pushing to expand these settlements in an attempt to secure support from their base, even as their electoral standing remains uncertain. International observers and the United Nations have expressed serious concern over these developments, noting that the ongoing actions are making the establishment of a future Palestinian state increasingly difficult.
amharic: እስራኤል በጥቅምት ወር ለምታካሂደው ምርጫ እየተዘጋጀች ባለችበት በዚህ ወቅት፣ በዌስት ባንክ የሚፈጸሙ ህገ-ወጥ የሰፈራ እንቅስቃሴዎችና ጥቃቶች በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ጨምረዋል። የቀኝ ዘመም ፖለቲከኞች የምርጫ ድጋፋቸውን ለማጠናከር ሲሉ እነዚህን ሰፈራዎች ለማስፋፋት ከፍተኛ ጥረት እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅትን ጨምሮ ሌሎች ዓለም አቀፍ አካላት እነዚህ ድርጊቶች የወደፊቱን የፍልስጤም መንግስት የመመስረት ዕድል በእጅጉ እንደሚጎዱት ስጋታቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Israa'el filannoo Onkololeessa dhufuuf qophaa'aa jirtuun wal-qabatee, hojiin qubannaa seera-an-dhabeessaafi walitti-buutiin naannoo West Bank daran dabalaa dhufeera. MootummaanIsraa'el keessatti gareen mirga-qabiyyee (hard-right) ta'an, deeggarsa filannoo argachuuf jechuudhaan babalina qubannaa kanaa ariifachiisaa jiru. Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii fi qaamoleen idil-addunyaa biroo, tarkaanfiin kun biyya Palastaayinii hundeesuuf carraa jiru kan dhiphisu ta'uu ibsuun yaaddoo qaban ibsataniiru.

title: Three lions die in Tokyo zoo as heatwave scorches East Asia
english: A severe and record-breaking heatwave across East Asia has caused the deaths of three lions at a Tokyo zoo due to suspected heatstroke. South Korea has officially declared a national disaster as temperatures reach historic highs, resulting in 19 human deaths and thousands of illnesses. Both Japan and the Korean Peninsula are struggling with dangerously high temperatures that are overwhelming healthcare systems and energy infrastructure.
amharic: በምስራቅ እስያ የተከሰተው ከፍተኛና ሪከርድ የሰበረ የሙቀት ማዕበል በቶኪዮ መካነ አራዊት ውስጥ ሶስት አንበሶች በሙቀት መጨናነቅ ሳቢያ እንዲሞቱ አድርጓል። ደቡብ ኮሪያ ከፍተኛ ሙቀቱ ያስከተለውን የሰው ህይወት መጥፋት ተከትሎ ብሄራዊ የአደጋ ጊዜ አውጃለች። በሁለቱም ሀገራት ያለው እጅግ ከፍተኛ ሙቀት የህዝብን ጤና በመጉዳት እና የኤሌክትሪክ ፍላጎትን በመጨመር ከፍተኛ ተጽዕኖ እያሳደረ ይገኛል።
oromo: Gubaa cimaa fi seenaa keessatti mul'atee hin beekne kan biyyoota Eshiyaa Bahaa keessatti mudateen, qeerransota sadii kanneen zoo tokko keessatti argaman du'aan ofirraa darbaniiru. Kooriyaan Kibbaa ho'a cimaa kana hordofee balaa biyyoolessaa labsitee jirti; namoonni hedduun dhukkubsatanii lubbuun namoota muraasni darbeera. Japanii fi Kooriyaa lamaanuu ho'a kana irraa kan ka'e rakkoo fayyaa fi humna ibsaa waliin walqabatu keessa seenanii jiru.

title: Jordan FA chief accuses FIFA’s Infantino of ‘blackmail’ over endorsement
english: Prince Ali bin Hussein, the head of Jordan’s Football Association, has publicly accused FIFA President Gianni Infantino of using blackmail to secure his support. According to the Prince, FIFA officials hinted that they would address Jordan's ongoing issues, such as player payments and tournament logistics, only if he agreed to endorse Infantino. This controversy follows the collapse of Infantino's failed plan to sell a stake in the World Cup, which has caused significant internal friction within global football leadership.
amharic: የዮርዳኖስ እግር ኳስ ማህበር ፕሬዝዳንት ልዑል አሊ ቢን ሁሴን፣ የፊፋው ፕሬዝዳንት ጃኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ ድጋፋቸውን ለማግኘት ማጭበርበር ወይም ማስፈራሪያ ተጠቅመዋል በማለት ከሰዋል። ልዑሉ እንዳሉት ፊፋ የዮርዳኖስን የገንዘብ እና የአስተዳደር ችግሮች ለመፍታት ቃል የገባው ኢንፋንቲኖን የሚደግፉ ከሆነ ብቻ ነው። ይህ ክስ የተሰማው ኢንፋንቲኖ የዓለም ዋንጫን ድርሻ ለመሸጥ ያቀረቡት ሀሳብ ውድቅ ከተደረገ በኋላ የፊፋ አመራሮች መካከል እየተፈጠረ ባለው አለመግባባት ወቅት ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Federeeshinii Kubbaa Miilaa Yordaanos, Amiir Ali Biin Huseen, pirezidaantii FIFA Jiyaanii Infaantiinoo deggersa isaanii argachuuf jecha 'shantakkii' ykn dhiibbaa seeraan alaa fayyadamaniiru jechuun himatan. Amiirichi akka jedhanitti, FIFA rakkoolee Yordaanos keessa jiran kan akka kaffaltii taphattootaa fi rakkoo viizaa furuuf waadaa kan gale, Infaantiinoo yoo deggaran qofa akka ta'e ibsan. Himannaan kun kan dhaga'ame erga yaanni Infaantiinoo qooda waancaa addunyaa gurguruu fi dhabamee booda, hogganoota FIFA gidduutti walitti buutiin uumamee jiruun wal qabatee dha.

title: Real Madrid: Vinicius Junior drops huge future hint amid Arsenal interest
english: Real Madrid forward Vinicius Junior is participating in pre-season training under new manager Jose Mourinho while navigating rumors of a potential transfer to Arsenal. Although he is in the final year of his current contract and negotiations are ongoing, the Brazilian star expressed optimism about the new season. He remains focused on his physical preparation and enjoying his football despite the uncertainty surrounding his future at the club.
amharic: የሪያል ማድሪዱ አጥቂ ቪኒሲየስ ጁኒየር ወደ አርሰናል ሊዘዋወር ይችላል በሚል ወሬዎች መካከል ከአዲሱ አሰልጣኝ ሆሴ ሞሪንሆ ጋር የቅድመ ውድድር ዘመን ልምምዱን እየሰራ ይገኛል። ተጫዋቹ አሁን ባለው የውል ስምምነት የመጨረሻ ዓመት ላይ ቢሆንም እና ድርድሮች እየተካሄዱ ቢሆንም፣ ስለ አዲሱ የውድድር ዘመን በጎ አስተሳሰብ አለው። በክለቡ ያለው የወደፊት ዕጣ ፈንታ እርግጠኛ ባይሆንም፣ በአሁኑ ጊዜ ትኩረቱን በአካል ብቃት ዝግጅት ላይ ብቻ አድርጓል።
oromo: Weerartuun garee Riyaal Maadrid Viiniishiyas Juuniyar, oduun gara Arsenal deemuuf jedhu yoo jiraatellee, leenjii dura-durii kan qophii isaa leenjisaa haaraa Joosee Mooriinyoo jalatti jalqabeera. Viiniishiyas waliigaltee isaa isa xumuraa irratti kan argamu yoo ta'u, mariin haala gara fuulduraa isaa irratti geggeeffamaa jiruus, waa'ee dorgommii haaraa haala gaariin yaadaa jira. Innis shakkii gara fuulduraa isaa jiru osoo hin ilaalin, xiyyeeffannaa isaa guutuu qophii qaamaa fi tapha isaa irratti taasiseera.

title: US depleted 'virtually all' long-range precision missiles during Iran war: Report
english: A recent report indicates that the United States has nearly run out of its advanced long-range precision missiles following its conflict with Iran. This shortage complicates potential military threats, as these weapons are essential for striking targets safely from a distance. To maintain operational capability, the U.S. military has been forced to transfer missile supplies from other regions.
amharic: የቅርብ ጊዜ ዘገባ እንደሚያመለክተው አሜሪካ ከኢራን ጋር ባደረገችው ግጭት ምክንያት የተራቀቁ የረጅም ርቀት ሚሳኤሎቿ ክምችት አልቋል። እነዚህ ሚሳኤሎች ከሩቅ ቦታ ሆነው ኢላማዎችን ለመምታት ወሳኝ በመሆናቸው፣ አሁን የተፈጠረው እጥረት የአሜሪካን የወታደራዊ ጥቃት አቅም ይገድባል። ሁኔታውን ለማስተካከልም አሜሪካ ከሌሎች አካባቢዎች ሚሳኤሎችን ወደ መካከለኛው ምስራቅ ለማዘዋወር ተገዳለች።
oromo: gabaasni dhihoo kun akka agarsiisutti, yuuniited isteets waraana Iiraan waliin taasisteen booda meeshaalee waraana kan fageenya dheeraa dhaahan hunda irratti dhabdeetti. Meeshaaleen kun diina irraa fagaatanii gadi fageenyaan haleeluuf kan gargaaran waan ta'eef, isaan dhabuun ishee humna waraanaa ishee irratti dhiibbaa uumeera. Kanaafuu, waraanni Yuuniited isteets gargaarsa meeshaalee waraanaa iddoo biraa irraa ergaa jirti.

title: White House set to extend Jones Act waiver to push down gas prices
english: The White House plans to extend a waiver of the Jones Act to help lower rising gasoline prices caused by the conflict between the U.S. and Iran. By easing strict shipping regulations, the government hopes to reduce transport bottlenecks and improve supply chain efficiency. This move comes as officials face pressure to control fuel costs ahead of the upcoming midterm elections.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል ባለው ጦርነት ምክንያት የተከሰተውን የነዳጅ ዋጋ ንረት ለመቆጣጠር የጆንስ ህግን ማሻሻያ ለማራዘም አቅዷል። ይህ እርምጃ የባህር ላይ ትራንስፖርት ደንቦችን በማላላት የነዳጅ አቅርቦትን ለማፋጠን ያለመ ነው። ይህም በመጪው የምርጫ ወቅት የነዳጅ ዋጋን ለማረጋጋት የሚደረግ ጥረት አካል ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa waraana Ameerikaafi Iraan gidduutti godhamaa jiruun kan ka'e gatiin boba'aa akka hir'atuuf seera 'Jones Act' jedhamu irratti hayyama kennamu dheereessuuf karoorfateera. Hayyamni kun imala markeboota irratti dambiiwwan jiran salphisuun boba'aan si'ataa akka dhihaatuuf gargaara. Tarkaanfiin kun filannoo dhuftu dura gatii boba'aa tasgabeessuuf kan gumaachu ta'a.

title: Activists storm Israeli Knesset meeting in protest against additional $36m for settlement expansion
english: Protesters interrupted an Israeli parliamentary committee meeting after officials approved a significant budget increase for settlement expansion in the West Bank. The funding, totaling $36 million, is designated for developing heritage and archaeological sites in the occupied territories. Committee members condemned the demonstrators' actions while the overall annual spending on settlements reached a historic high.

title: US depleted 'virtually all' long-range precision missiles during Iran war: Report
english: A recent report indicates that the United States has nearly exhausted its supply of critical long-range precision missiles due to the ongoing conflict with Iran. The military has been forced to pull weapons from other global regions to maintain operations, raising concerns about the sustainability of the U.S. arsenal. These shortages, which also include defensive interceptors, are fueling criticism that the prolonged war is significantly depleting American military resources.

title: Israel-Lebanon talks have begun in Rome, US State Department says
english: US-mediated discussions between Israel and Lebanon have kicked off in Rome to address regional security concerns. The three-day meetings focus on disarming Hezbollah, withdrawing Israeli troops from southern Lebanon, and establishing a lasting peace agreement. These talks build on previous diplomatic efforts and successful pilot programs aimed at stabilizing the area.

Mariin kun carraaqqii dippilomaasii kanaan duraa fi hojiiwwan nagaa mirkaneessuuf jalqabaman irratti kan hundaa'e dha.

title: Video shows Russian drone chasing Ukrainian street vendor in 'human safari' attack
english: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky shared footage showing a Russian drone intentionally hunting and exploding near a civilian street vendor in the Kherson region. The victim, a 52-year-old man, survived the attack with shrapnel injuries after the drone pursued him despite his attempts to show he was not a combatant. Ukrainian officials have condemned the incident as a barbaric 'human safari,' describing it as part of a systematic Russian strategy to terrorize civilians in frontline areas.

title: EU commends Spain's 'swift response' to Ceuta migrant crisis
english: The European Union has officially supported Spain's handling of the recent migrant crisis in Ceuta, where thousands crossed into the territory. Despite earlier criticism and travel restrictions imposed by countries like Italy, EU officials emphasized the need for a unified approach to migration. Most of the individuals who arrived in the region have since been returned to Morocco following the massive influx.

title: EU offers emergency aid to Spain to strengthen Ceuta border
english: The European Union has decided to provide emergency support to Spain to help manage the border in Ceuta. This decision followed an urgent meeting of all 27 member states to address the recent arrival of over 70,000 migrants from Morocco. The aid is intended to bolster security measures and better control the situation at this Spanish enclave.

title: Ivory Coast reappoint Herve Renard for attempt at repeat of AFCON title
english: The Ivory Coast football federation has reappointed Herve Renard as head coach to lead the national team. Renard, who previously guided the country to an AFCON title in 2015, replaces Emerse Fae following his departure after the 2026 World Cup. The experienced coach now aims to secure his third career Africa Cup of Nations victory in next year's tournament held in Kenya, Tanzania, and Uganda.
amharic: የአይቮሪ ኮስት እግር ኳስ ፌዴሬሽን አሰልጣኝ ኤርቬ ሬናርድን የብሄራዊ ቡድኑ ዋና አሰልጣኝ አድርጎ ዳግም ሾሟቸዋል። በ2015 የአፍሪካ ዋንጫን ለአገሪቱ ያስገኙት ሬናርድ፣ ከ2026 የዓለም ዋንጫ በኋላ ስራቸውን የለቀቁትን ኤመርሴ ፋኤን ተክተዋል። ልምድ ያለው አሰልጣኝ በሚቀጥለው ዓመት በኬንያ፣ ታንዛኒያ እና ዩጋንዳ በሚካሄደው የአፍሪካ ዋንጫ ለሶስተኛ ጊዜ አህጉራዊውን ዋንጫ ለማንሳት ይሞክራሉ።

Leenjiisaan muuxannoo qaban kun bara dhufu biyyoota Keeniyaa, Taanzaniyaa fi Yugaandaa keessatti qophaa'u waancaa Afrikaa yeroo sadaffaaf injifachuuf karoorfataniiru.

title: UEFA’s threatened legal action against Infantino and FIFA: What we know
english: UEFA has initiated formal legal preparations against FIFA and President Gianni Infantino regarding a controversial proposal to sell private investment stakes in major tournaments. By issuing a document preservation letter, UEFA is compelling FIFA officials to secure all relevant records for potential future litigation. This move follows a period of intense conflict and a loss of confidence in leadership, marking a significant step in challenging FIFA's internal decision-making processes.
amharic: የአውሮፓ እግር ኳስ ማህበር (UEFA) በዓለም አቀፉ የእግር ኳስ አስተዳደር አካል (FIFA) እና በፕሬዚዳንቱ  Gianni Infantino ላይ የሕግ እርምጃ ለመውሰድ ዝግጅት እያደረገ ነው። ይህ ውዝግብ የተፈጠረው FIFA በዋንጫ ውድድሮች ላይ የውስጥ ድርሻ ለመሸጥ ባቀረበው አወዛጋቢ ዕቅድ ነው። UEFA ማስረጃዎችን እንዳይጠፉ የሚያግድ የሕግ ደብዳቤ በመላክ፣ FIFA ለወደፊት ሊመጣ ለሚችለው ክስ አስፈላጊ የሆኑ ሰነዶችን እንዲጠብቅ አስገድዶታል።

title: India denies involvement in ex-Bangladesh PM Hasina’s planned speech
english: The Indian government has clarified that it has no role in organizing a planned virtual address by former Bangladeshi Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina. Bangladesh had expressed concerns that allowing such political activity could damage diplomatic relations, while also banning local media from broadcasting her speech. Hasina remains in exile in India following her ousting in 2024 and faces a death sentence for her role in the government crackdown during the protests.
amharic: የሕንድ መንግሥት የቀድሞዋ የባንግላዴሽ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሼክ ሀሲና በኢንተርኔት አማካኝነት ሊያደርጉት ያሰቡትን ንግግር ከማዘጋጀት ጋር ምንም ግንኙነት እንደሌለው አስታውቋል። ባንግላዴሽ ይህ የፖለቲካ እንቅስቃሴ በሁለቱ አገራት የዲፕሎማሲ ግንኙነት ላይ ጉዳት ሊያደርስ ይችላል በሚል ስጋት የገለጸች ሲሆን፣ በአገሪቱ ውስጥ ንግግሯን በዜና ማሰራጫዎች እንዳይተላለፍ ከልክላለች። እ.ኤ.አ በ2024 ከስልጣን የተባረሩት ሀሲና በአሁኑ ወቅት በሕንድ በግዞት የሚገኙ ሲሆን፣ ተቃውሞዎችን በመጨፍለቅ ወንጀልም የሞት ፍርድ ተፈርዶባቸዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Hindii pirezidaantii duraanii Baangilaadesh Sheek Haasinaan haasawaa viidiyoon gochuuf karoorfatan wajjin walqabatee gahee akka hin qabne ibseera. Baangilaadesh gochi kun hariiroo dippilomaasii biyyoota lamaanii miidhuu danda'a jechuun yaaddoo kan qabdu yoo ta'u, miidiyaaleen biyyattii keessatti haasawaa ishee akka hin dabarsine dhorkiteetti. Haasinaan bara 2024 aangoo irraa erga bu'anii booda Hinditti baqattummaan kan jiraatan yoo ta'u, hiriira mormii irratti tarkaanfii fudhataniin walqabatee adabbii du'aa itti murameera.

title: Photos: Guatemala’s Fuego volcano erupts, forcing evacuations
english: Guatemala's Fuego volcano recently erupted, leading officials to issue a high-level emergency alert. Residents in surrounding villages have been evacuated as the volcano releases lava and massive ash clouds reaching up to six kilometers high. Authorities are concerned about potential explosive activity and dangerous debris flows, following previous deadly eruptions in the region.
amharic: የጓቲማላው የፉኤጎ እሳተ ገሞራ በቅርቡ በመፈንዳቱ ባለስልጣናት ከፍተኛ የአስቸኳይ ጊዜ ጥንቃቄ አውጀዋል። እሳተ ገሞራው ላቫ እና እስከ ስድስት ኪሎ ሜትር ከፍታ ያለው አመድ በመልቀቁ በአቅራቢያው የሚኖሩ ነዋሪዎች ከቀያቸው እንዲለቁ ተደርጓል። ባለስልጣናት በክልሉ ከዚህ ቀደም የደረሱ አደገኛ ፍንዳታዎችን ታሳቢ በማድረግ፣ ተጨማሪ የፍንዳታ አደጋ ሊኖር እንደሚችል ስጋታቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Gaarri ibiddaa Fuego kan biyya Gwatimaala keessatti argamu erga dhohee booda, mootummaan akeekkachiisa hatattamaa olaanaa labseera. Gaarri kun laava fi daaraa hanga kiilomeetira ja’a ol ka’u waan gadhiiseef, namoonni naannichatti argaman akka godaanan taasifameera. Dhoohi kun daran hammaachuu fi dhangala’aan ibiddaa miidhaa geessisuu akka danda’u waajjirri to’annoo gaara ibiddaa akeekkachiiseera.

title: Oil prices fall on hopes Strait of Hormuz could reopen
english: Oil prices dropped to a three-week low after US officials expressed optimism about reaching a deal with Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Senior American leaders are currently negotiating to restore shipping access, which has been severely restricted for months. This potential resolution could ease global supply concerns and eventually lead to lower fuel prices for consumers worldwide.
amharic: የሆርሙዝ የባህር በር ይከፈታል በሚል ተስፋ የነዳጅ ዋጋ ባለፉት ሶስት ሳምንታት ውስጥ ዝቅተኛው ደረጃ ላይ ደርሷል። የአሜሪካ ከፍተኛ ባለስልጣናት ከኢራን ጋር በመነጋገር የነዳጅ ማጓጓዣ መንገዱን በቅርቡ ለመክፈት እየሰሩ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። ይህ ስምምነት ከተሳካ በአለም አቀፍ ደረጃ የነዳጅ አቅርቦት ችግር ተቃሎ የነዳጅ ዋጋ እንዲቀንስ አስተዋጽኦ ያደርጋል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Gatiin boba'aa ji'a sadii keessatti sadarkaa isa gadi aanaatti kan kufe yoo ta'u, kunis mootummaan Ameerikaa daandii galaana Hormuz banuuf Iran waliin marii cimaa gochaa jirachuu isaanitiin wal qabata. Hogganoonni Ameerikaa dhimmi kun guyyoota dhufan keessatti furata akka argatu abdii qabu. Furmaatni kunis dhiyeessii boba'aa adunyaa kan tasgabbeessuufi gatii boba'aa gara fuulduraatti hir'isuuf gumaacha qabaata.

title: Qatar says US-Iran mediation efforts continuing but no direct talks planned
english: Qatar and other regional mediators are working to ease tensions between the United States and Iran, though no direct negotiations between the two nations are currently scheduled. While officials hope to restart broader diplomatic dialogue, the current focus is mainly on securing an agreement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz to commercial shipping. Amid these efforts, security remains fragile following recent reports of a vessel being struck in the Gulf.
amharic: ኳታር እና ሌሎች ቀጠናዊ አደራዳሪዎች በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል ያለውን ውጥረት ለማርገብ እየሰሩ ቢሆንም፣ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ቀጥተኛ ድርድር ለማድረግ የታቀደ ነገር የለም። ምንም እንኳን ባለስልጣናት ሰፊ የዲፕሎማሲ ንግግሮችን ለመጀመር ተስፋ ቢያደርጉም፣ አሁን ያለው ትኩረት የሆርሙዝ የባህር ወሽመጥን ለንግድ መርከቦች ለመክፈት በሚያስችል ስምምነት ላይ ነው። በእነዚህ ጥረቶች መካከል በባህረ ሰላጤው ውስጥ በአንድ መርከብ ላይ ጥቃት መድረሱን ተከትሎ የፀጥታው ሁኔታ አሁንም አሳሳቢ ሆኖ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Qatar fi biyyoonni giddu galeessa biroo walitti bu'iinsa Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduu jiru tasgabbeessuuf carraaqqii gochaa jiru; ta'us, mariin kallattiin biyyoota lamaan gidduutti godhamu hin jiru. Aangooti marii bal'aa gaggeessuuf abdi qabaatanis, xiyyeeffannaan ammaa bishaan galtee hormuz daldalaaf banuuf waliigaltee irra ga'uu irratti ta'eera. Carraaqqiin kun osoo itti fufuun jiruu, galana garba kana keessatti markaba tokko irratti haleellaan raawwatamuun isaa sodaa nageenyaa biyyaatti uumeera.

title: Photos: Thousands in Gaza City join mass funeral for 112 Palestinians
english: Thousands of people in Gaza City gathered for a mass funeral to honor 112 Palestinians, including many children, who were killed in an Israeli airstrike back in 2023. Their remains were only recently recovered from the rubble of a collapsed building in the Sabra neighborhood after a two-week excavation effort. The mourners used this tragic event to call for international investigations into the attack and to highlight the ongoing issue of bodies still trapped under debris across the region.
amharic: በጋዛ ከተማ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች እ.ኤ.አ. በ2023 በእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት ህይወታቸው ያለፈ 112 ፍልስጤማውያንን ለመቅበር ተገኝተዋል። የሟቾች አስከሬን ለሁለት ሳምንታት በዘለቀ ፍለጋ በሳብራ ሰፈር ፍርስራሽ ውስጥ ከተገኘ በኋላ ነው የቀብር ስነ-ስርዓቱ የተከናወነው። የሟቾች ቤተሰቦችና ሀዘንተኞች ይህንን አሳዛኝ ክስተት በመጠቀም አለም አቀፍ ምርመራ እንዲደረግ እና በፍርስራሽ ስር ያሉ ሌሎች አስከሬኖች እንዲወጡ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል።
oromo: Magaalaa Gaazaatti namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman, bara 2023 haleellaa xiyyaaraa Israa'eliin lubbuun isaanii darbe namoota 112 ta'aniif sirna awwalchaa guddaa raawwataniiru. Qaamni miidhamaa kunneenis erga haleellaan raawwatamee waggaa sadii booda, naannoo Sabraatti mana jigaa jala duubatti erga barbaadamee booda argame. Namoonni gaddan kunis, miidhaa kanaaf qorannoon idil-addunyaa akka gaggeeffamu fi qaamni namoota biroo qulqulluu ta'ee jigaa jala jiru akka ba'u gaafataniiru.

title: Beirut port blast anniversary overshadowed by new wave of destruction
english: The fourth anniversary of the devastating Beirut port explosion has been eclipsed by ongoing military conflict in southern Lebanon. Families of the 2020 blast victims continue to seek justice as new Israeli airstrikes leave many residents homeless and struggling to survive. This latest destruction compounds the hardships faced by a population already suffering from a long-standing economic collapse and a lack of political accountability.
amharic: የቤሩት ወደብ ፍንዳታ አራተኛ ዓመት በደቡብ ሊባኖስ እየተካሄደ ባለው የጦር ግጭት ምክንያት በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ተጋርዶ ውሏል። የ2020ዱ አደጋ ተጎጂዎች ፍትህን መጠየቃቸውን ቢቀጥሉም፣ በአሁኑ ወቅት በእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃቶች ምክንያት ብዙ ነዋሪዎች መኖሪያ ቤታቸውን በማጣታቸው ለከፍተኛ ችግር ተዳርገዋል። ይህ አዲስ ጥፋት ቀደም ሲል በኢኮኖሚ ውድቀት እና በመንግስት አስተዳደር ጉድለት ሲማቅቅ በነበረው የሊባኖስ ህዝብ ላይ ተጨማሪ ጫና ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Guyyaan yaadannoo waggaa afraffaa balaa dhoohinsa buufata doonii Beeyirutii, waraana kibba Libaanositti adeemsifamaa jiruun saadhamee ooleera. Maatiin miidhamtoota balaa bara 2020 sanaa haqni akka laatamu gaafachuu itti fufanis, haleellaa qilleensaa Israa'el qaqqabsiisaa jirtuun namoonni hedduu manneen isaanii dhabanii rakkoo hamaaf saaxilamaniiru. Miidhaan haaraan kun, ummata Libaanos kan kanaan dura kufuun dinagdee fi hanqina bulchiinsaan miidhamaa ture irratti gidiraa dabalataa ta'eera.

title: FIFA denies Infantino sought Trump backing after failed World Cup selloff
english: FIFA has officially rejected reports claiming that President Gianni Infantino reached out to the Trump administration for support following the failure of a major commercial deal. The organization labeled these allegations as false, specifically denying that Infantino tried to contact US officials after his plan to sell a significant stake in World Cup broadcasting rights was abandoned. This controversy arises amid growing pressure on Infantino regarding his leadership future as he faces backlash from stakeholders.
amharic: ፊፋ የዓለም ዋንጫ የንግድ መብት ሽያጭ እቅዱ መክሸፉን ተከትሎ የፊፋው ፕሬዝዳንት ጂያኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ ከዶናልድ ትራምፕ አስተዳደር ድጋፍ ጠይቀዋል የሚለውን ዘገባ በሀሰት ወሬነት አጣጥሏል። ፊፋ ኢንፋንቲኖ ከዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ባለስልጣናት ጋር ለመገናኘት ሞክረዋል የተባለው ወሬ ምንም እውነት የለውም ብሏል። ይህ ክስተት የኢንፋንቲኖን የፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንትነት ቀጣይ ዕጣ ፈንታ በተመለከተ በባለድርሻ አካላት ዘንድ ትልቅ ትኩረት እና ትችት እያስነሳ ይገኛል።
oromo: FIFA gabaasa Prezidaantiin FIFA Giyaanii Infantinoo karoorri gurgurtaa mirga daldalaa Waancaa Addunyaa erga fashaleen booda mootummaa Traampii irraa deeggarsa gaafatan jedhu dhugaa miti jedhee haaleera. FIFA gabaasichi hiikaa tokko kan hin qabneefi soba akka ta'e ibseera. Kanneen keessatti Infantinoo hoggansa isaa fi egeree isaa ilaalchisee hiriyoota kubbaa miillaa fi qaamolee dhimmi kun isaan ilaallatu irraa komii cimaa mudachaa jira.

title: Why are oil companies posting record profits amid Iran war disruption?
english: Global energy markets are experiencing significant instability due to the closure of the Strait of Hormuz during the ongoing conflict with Iran. This disruption has caused oil prices to spike worldwide, leading major corporations like ExxonMobil, Chevron, and Shell to report record-breaking quarterly profits. While the war creates economic hardship for consumers, these companies are benefiting from the surging market costs and expanded profit margins.
amharic: ከኢራን ጋር በተፈጠረው ግጭት ምክንያት የሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ በመዘጋቱ በአለም አቀፍ የነዳጅ ገበያ ላይ ከፍተኛ መስተጓጎል ተፈጥሯል። ይህም የነዳጅ ዋጋ በአለም አቀፍ ደረጃ እንዲጨምር በማድረጉ፣ እንደ ኤክሰን ሞቢል፣ ሼቭሮን እና ሼል ያሉ ትላልቅ የነዳጅ ኩባንያዎች ከፍተኛ የትርፍ መጠን እንዲያመዘግቡ አድርጓቸዋል። ጦርነቱ በህዝብ ላይ ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጫና እየፈጠረ ቢሆንም፣ እነዚህ ኩባንያዎች ግን ከነዳጅ ዋጋ ንረት ከፍተኛ ትርፍ እያገኙ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Waraana Iran waliin walqabatee cufamuu daandii galaana Hormuz irraa kan ka'e, gabaan boba'aa addunyaa jeeqamee jira. Kunis gatiin boba'aa addunyaa maratti akka dabalu waan taasiseef, dhaabbileen boba'aa gurguddoon akka ExxonMobil, Chevron fi Shell bu'aa baasii isaanii keessatti rikardii cabsuu danda'aniiru. Waraanichi lammiilee irratti rakkoo dinagdee kan uumu ta'us, dhaabbileen kunneen garuu gatiin boba'aa dabaluu isaa irraa fayyadamaa jiru.

title: Spanish PM Sanchez faces criticism as EU meets over Ceuta crossings
english: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez is under pressure from European leaders following a massive and tragic migration surge into the Spanish territory of Ceuta. While most of the 60,000 individuals who entered have returned to Morocco, the incident has reignited deep divisions within the EU regarding how to manage external borders and humanitarian responsibilities. Italy has notably criticized Spain's response, though Prime Minister Sanchez defended his government by pointing to broader migration trends across the bloc.
amharic: የስፔኑ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ፔድሮ ሳንቼዝ በስፔን ግዛት ሴኡታ ውስጥ በተከሰተው ከፍተኛ የስደተኞች መጉረፍ ሳቢያ ከአውሮፓውያን መሪዎች ትችት እየቀረበባቸው ነው። ወደ ስፔን ከገቡት 60,000 ሰዎች መካከል አብዛኞቹ ወደ ሞሮኮ የተመለሱ ቢሆንም፣ ይህ ክስተት በአውሮፓ ህብረት ውስጥ የድንበር ደህንነትን እና የሰብአዊ መብት ግዴታዎችን በተመለከተ ያለውን ልዩነት አባብሶታል። የጣሊያን መንግስት የስፔንን አያያዝ በመተቸቱ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሳንቼዝ የሃገራቸውን ድርጊት በመከላከል ምላሽ ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Mummichi ministeeraa Ispeen Pedro Sanchez erga namoonni 60,000 ol ta'an naannoo Ceuta seenanii booda mormii fi qeeqa gaggeessitoota Awurooppaa irraa isa mudachaa jira. Namoonni hedduun gara Morookootti deebi'anis, raawwiin kun rakkoo daangaa fi mirga namummaa irratti biyyoota Gamtaa Awurooppaa gidduutti wal dhabdee uumee jira. Mootummaan Xaaliyaanii tarkaanfii mootummaan Ispeen fudhate kan qeeqe yoo ta'u, Mummichi ministeeraa Sanchez ammoo qeeqa kana mormuun hojii mootummaa isaa irra deebi'ee ibseera.

title: Labour Friends of Israel defends major West Bank settlement blocs
english: The Labour Friends of Israel (LFI) lobby group has released a report arguing against a potential British government ban on products from Israeli settlements in the West Bank. While the International Court of Justice considers all these settlements illegal, the LFI report suggests that major settlement blocs should be treated differently and that a total trade boycott is impractical. This position challenges the current government's consideration of stricter measures against settlement imports in response to ongoing regional violence.
amharic: የሌበር ፍሬንድስ ኦፍ እስራኤል (LFI) ቡድን በዌስት ባንክ በሚገኙ የእስራኤል ሰፈራዎች ላይ የብሪታንያ መንግስት የንግድ እገዳ እንዳይጥል የሚጠይቅ ሪፖርት አውጥቷል። ምንም እንኳን ዓለም አቀፍ ፍርድ ቤት እነዚህ ሰፈራዎች በሙሉ ህገ-ወጥ እንደሆኑ ቢገልጽም፣ የLFI ሪፖርት ዋና ዋናዎቹን የሰፈራ ማዕከላት እንደ ልዩ ጉዳይ በመመልከት አጠቃላይ የንግድ እገዳው ተገቢ እንዳልሆነ ይከራከራል። ይህ አቋም መንግስት በክልሉ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን ግጭት ለመግታት ከሚወስዳቸው እርምጃዎች ጋር የተያያዘ ነው።
oromo: Gareen 'Labour Friends of Israel' (LFI) jedhamu, mootummaan Britaniyaa meeshaalee naannoo West Bank keessa jiran kan qubata Israa'elootaa irraa dhufan akka hin dhowwine gabaasa baasee jira. Manneen murtii idil-addunyaa qubatni kunneen hundi seeraan alaa dha jedhanii yoo amananiyyi, gabaasni LFI garuu ganda gurguddaa ta'an adda baasanii ilaaluun fi daldala guututti dhowwuun akka hin danda'amne ni dubbata. Yaanni kunis, mootummaan ammaa naannichatti jeequmsa jiru sababeeffachuun meeshaalee qubata san irraa dhufan irratti tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuuf karoorfatuuf mormii ta'eera.

title: Afternoon update
english: The United States and Iran are engaged in discussions regarding the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, with US officials expressing optimism that an agreement could be reached soon despite Iran's lack of formal confirmation. While tensions remain high, the potential for a diplomatic resolution has already caused global oil prices to drop. Meanwhile, Lebanon and Israel have begun a new round of direct negotiations in Rome despite domestic criticism from Hezbollah.
amharic: አሜሪካ እና ኢራን በሆርሙዝ የባህር ወሽመጥ ዳግም መከፈት ዙሪያ ድርድር እያደረጉ ሲሆን፣ የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት ስምምነት ላይ ለመድረስ ያላቸውን ተስፋ ገልጸዋል። በኢራን በኩል ይፋዊ ማረጋገጫ ባይሰጥም፣ የድርድሩ መጀመር የነዳጅ ዋጋ እንዲቀንስ አድርጓል። በተመሳሳይ ሁኔታ ሊባኖስ እና እስራኤል በሮም ቀጥተኛ ውይይት መጀመራቸው ተሰምቷል።
oromo: Ameerikaan fi Iraan walta'iinsa daandii galaana Hormuz deebisanii banuuf marii gochaa jiru, ta'us Iraan ammaaf of eeggannoodhaan dubbachaa jirti. Mariin kun abdii uumee waan jiruuf gatiin boba'aa addunyaa irratti gadi bu'eera. Gama biraatiin, biyyoonni Libaanoos fi Israa'el marii kallattii ta'e tokko Room keessatti eegalaniiru.

title: Has the UAE's meteoric rise reached its limit?
english: Over the past two decades, the United Arab Emirates has transformed from a quiet Gulf state into a powerful regional influence by leveraging its wealth, military strength, and diplomatic partnerships. This rise was largely fueled by the country's ability to navigate regional power vacuums created by major Middle Eastern conflicts and shifting global alliances. However, as the geopolitical landscape evolves, experts are now questioning whether the UAE can sustain its assertive foreign policy in the long term.
amharic: ባለፉት ሁለት አስርት ዓመታት ውስጥ የተባበሩት አረብ ኤሚሬቶች ባላት የገንዘብ ሀብት፣ ወታደራዊ አቅም እና ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነቶች በመጠቀም ከጸጥተኛ የባህረ ሰላጤ አገር ወደ ክልላዊ ተጽዕኖ ፈጣሪ ኃይልነት አድጋለች። ይህ እድገት የተመቻቸው በክልሉ በተከሰቱ ግጭቶች እና በትልልቅ አገራት መካከል በተፈጠሩ ክፍተቶች በመጠቀም ነው። ይሁን እንጂ፣ በአሁኑ ወቅት እየተለዋወጠ ባለው የፖለቲካ ሁኔታ ምክንያት ኤሚሬቶች ይህንን ተጽዕኖ ፈጣሪ የውጭ ፖሊሲዋን ለረጅም ጊዜ ማስቀጠል ትችል እንደሆነ ጥያቄዎች እየተነሱ ነው።
oromo: Ganna darban keessatti, biyyi Emireetota Gamtoomanii (UAE) qabeenya, humna waraanaa fi hariiroo dippilomaasii fayyadamuudhaan biyya nagaa turee gara biyya dhiibbaa guddaa qabduutti jijjiiramteetti. Guddinnii kunis, rakkoolee naannichaa keessatti uumaman fayyadamuu fi duwwaalee siyaasaa addunyaa iratti mul'atan guutuudhaan danda'ameera. Haa ta'u malee, yeroo ammaa haalli siyaasaa addunyaa jijjiiramaa waan jiruuf, Emireetonni siyaasa alaa ishee kana fuuldurattis itti fufsiisuu dandeessi moo hin dandeessu kan jedhu irratti shakkiiwwan jiru.

title: Marco Rubio says progress has been made in talks with Iran
english: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio announced that negotiations with Iran are advancing, although a formal resolution has not been reached. He expressed optimism that an agreement could be finalized in the near future. Meanwhile, President Donald Trump has issued a stern warning, stating that this represents Iran's final opportunity to settle the dispute before facing severe consequences.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ማርኮ ሩቢዮ ከኢራን ጋር እየተደረጉ ባሉ ድርድሮች ላይ መሻሻሎች ቢኖሩም እስካሁን የመጨረሻ ስምምነት ላይ አለመደረሱን አስታውቀዋል። ድርድሩ በቅርቡ እንደሚጠናቀቅ ተስፋ እንዳላቸውም ገልጸዋል። በሌላ በኩል ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ይህ ለኢራን የመጨረሻው የድርድር ዕድል እንደሆነ እና ስምምነት ላይ ካልደረሱ ከባድ እርምጃ እንደሚወሰድባቸው አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Ameerikaa Maarkoo Ruubiyooon marii biyyattii fi Iraan gidduutti godhamaa jiru irratti guddinni jiruus, hanga ammaatti waliigalteen xumuraa akka hin irra ga’amin ibsaniiru. Dhiheenya kana waliigaltee irra gahuuf abdii qabaachuu isaanii dubbataniiru. Gama biraatiin, Preezidaant Doonaald Traamp Iraan dhimma kana irratti waliigaltee irra gahuuf carraan isheen qabdu inni dhumaa akka ta’e fi osoo hin milkaa’in hafte tarkaanfii cimaan kan fudhatamu ta’uu akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Oil prices fall amid hopes of US-Iran deal
english: Global oil prices dropped significantly following reports that the United States and Iran have restarted negotiations. Officials suggested that a diplomatic agreement might be reached very soon, which helped calm fears regarding potential energy supply issues. Consequently, stock markets showed positive growth, with major US indexes recording notable gains.
amharic: በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል ድርድር እንደገና መጀመሩን ተከትሎ የአለም የነዳጅ ዋጋ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ቀንሷል። የሁለቱ ሀገራት ስምምነት በቅርቡ ሊፈጸም እንደሚችል መገለጹ የነዳጅ አቅርቦት መስተጓጎል ስጋትን በማቀዝቀዙ የዋጋ መውረዱን አስከትሏል። ይህ ሁኔታ የአሜሪካ የአክሲዮን ገበያ ላይ አዎንታዊ ተጽዕኖ በመፍጠር አክሲዮኖች ዋጋ እንዲጨምሩ አድርጓል።
oromo: Hirmaannaan marii biyyoota Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduutti jalqabamuun isaa gatiin boba'aa addunyaa akka hir'atu godheera. Walii galteen biyyoota lamaanii dhihoo keessatti akka milkaa'u dubbatamuun isaa, dhiyeessiin boba'aa adda cita jedhamee sodaatamaa ture akka tasgabbaa'u gargaareera. Haalli kun gabaa aksiyoonaa Ameerikaa irratti dhiibbaa gaarii uumee, gatiin aksiyoonotaa akka ol ka'u taasiseera.

title: Twelve years after ISIL’s massacres, thousands of Yazidis seek justice
english: The Yazidi community in Iraq is commemorating the twelfth anniversary of the 2014 ISIL attacks on Sinjar, an event officially classified by the UN as a genocide. Despite the passage of time, thousands of survivors are still displaced from their homes or remain unaccounted for. The community continues to call for international support to achieve justice and facilitate their safe return.
amharic: የኢራቅ የያዚዲ ማህበረሰብ በሲንጃር ላይ የተፈጸመው የISIS ጥቃት 12ኛ ዓመት መታሰቢያን እያከበሩ ነው። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት የዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀል ብሎ በፈረጀው በዚህ ጥቃት የተረፉ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች አሁንም ከመኖሪያ ቀያቸው ተፈናቅለዋል ወይም የት እንዳሉ አይታወቅም። ማህበረሰቡ ፍትህ ለማግኘት እና ወደ ቀያቸው ለመመለስ የሚያስችል አለም አቀፍ ድጋፍ እንዲደረግላቸው እየጠየቁ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Hawaasni Yazidii Iraaq keessa jiraatan, haleellaa bara 2014 gareen ISIL magaala Sinjaar irratti raawwateen waggaa 12 guutuu isaanii yaadachaa jiru. Gamtaan Mootummootaa haleellaa kana fixiinsa sanyii jechuun beekamtii kenneefii jira. Hanga ammaatti, namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman qe'ee isaanii irraa buqqa'anii jiru ykn bakka buutee isaanii hin beekamu; hawaasichis haqni akka argamuufi gara mana isaanii akka deebi'an gargaarsa addunyaa gaafachaa jira.

title: More than 150 people rescued in English Channel after boat catches fire
english: A major rescue operation involving British and French authorities successfully saved over 150 migrants after their boat caught fire in the English Channel. The group had previously refused assistance during their journey before the vessel's engine malfunctioned, forcing many to jump into the water. This incident highlights the ongoing political tensions in the UK regarding small boat crossings and asylum policies.

title: Six years after Beirut blast, families fight for truth
english: Six years after a massive explosion at the Beirut port caused by improperly stored chemicals, grieving families are still demanding justice and accountability from the government. The 2020 blast killed over 200 people and devastated the city, leaving a lasting scar on the community. Despite the passage of time, survivors and relatives of the victims remain united in their fight to ensure those responsible for the tragedy are held accountable.

title: Seventh round of Israel-Lebanon talks begins – what’s on the agenda?
english: A seventh round of US-mediated diplomatic talks has commenced in Rome, involving senior political and military officials from Israel and Lebanon. The primary goal of these discussions is to establish pilot zones that would allow for an Israeli military withdrawal and a handover of security control to the Lebanese army. Despite a previous ceasefire agreement, conflict has persisted, and negotiators are now working to secure a lasting resolution to the ongoing hostilities.

title: Can Pakistan keep US-Iran diplomacy alive as mistrust deepens?
english: Pakistan is stepping up its diplomatic efforts to revive talks between Iran and the United States amid growing tensions and failed ceasefires. Pakistani officials have invited high-ranking Iranian representatives to Islamabad to explore a peaceful path forward. Despite recent threats from President Trump and denials of direct engagement from Tehran, Pakistan remains committed to its role as a key mediator to help resolve the ongoing conflict.

title: Israel suffers record emigration wave, with almost 270,000 leaving since 2023
english: A recent study from Tel Aviv University reveals that Israel is experiencing its largest wave of emigration in history, with nearly 270,000 citizens leaving the country since 2023. Researchers noted that the departure of many skilled professionals, such as doctors and engineers, creates a significant risk for the nation’s future economy and security. Experts warn that if this trend continues to grow, it could become a self-sustaining cycle that is increasingly difficult to reverse.

title: Board of Peace caves to Netanyahu and rewrites Israeli withdrawal terms from Gaza
english: The U.S.-supported Board of Peace has adjusted its Gaza withdrawal plan following discussions with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. The board now mandates that all Hamas weaponry and tunnels must be fully neutralized before Israeli forces retreat past the Yellow Line. This decision replaces the previous gradual withdrawal strategy, effectively hardening the requirements for ending the military occupation.

title: US has used 'virtually all' of its long-range precision missiles during Iran war, say sources
english: Following five months of conflict with Iran, the United States has depleted nearly its entire inventory of long-range surface-to-surface precision missiles. Reports indicate that the military has utilized almost all of its ATACMS and about half of its global supply of Tomahawk missiles. This significant consumption has forced the U.S. Central Command to pull resources from other global regions to maintain their operational capabilities.
