title: Board of Peace caves to Netanyahu and rewrites Israeli withdrawal terms from Gaza
english: The U.S.-supported Board of Peace has adjusted its Gaza withdrawal strategy to align with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s demands. It now requires the total disarmament of Hamas before any Israeli forces retreat from their current positions, moving away from its previous proposal for a gradual, phased withdrawal. This shift has raised concerns that the peace process may be stalled, as it contradicts earlier agreements and allows Israel to maintain its military presence and offensive operations.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ድጋፍ ያለው የሰላም ቦርድ የጋዛን ለቀው የመውጣት ስትራቴጂውን ከጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ ፍላጎት ጋር በማጣጣም ቀይሮታል። ቦርዱ ቀደም ሲል የነበረውን የደረጃ በደረጃ የመውጣት እቅድ በመተው፣ የእስራኤል ጦር ከያዘው ቦታ ከመውጣቱ በፊት የሃማስ ታጣቂዎች ሙሉ በሙሉ ትጥቅ መፍታት አለባቸው የሚል አቋም ይዟል። ይህ ለውጥ ከቀድሞው ስምምነት ጋር የሚጋጭ በመሆኑ እና እስራኤል ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴዋን እንድትቀጥል ስለሚፈቅድ የሰላም ሂደቱን አደጋ ላይ ሊጥል እንደሚችል ተገልጿል።
oromo: Boordiin nageenyaa kan Ameerikaan deggeramu, tarsiimoo isaa kan gadi lhiquu Gaaza irraa dhufe irratti jijjiirama gochuun fedhii muummee ministiraa Benjaamin Netaaniyaahuu hordofuu jalqabeera. Kanaan dura sagantaa sadarkaa sadarkaan gadi lhiquu ture dhiisuun, waraanni Israa'eel bakka amma irra jiru gadhiisee bahuu dura, gareen Hamaas hidhannoosaa guutummaatti hiikkachuu qaba jedhee jira. Jijjiiramni kun kutaalee dura waliigalamanii turan wajjin kan wal-faallessuufi Israa'eel humna waraanaashee akkasumas haleellaashee akka itti fuftu kan hayyamu waan ta'eef, adeemsi nageenyaa sun dhiphachuu akka danda'u ibsameera.

title: US-Saudi strikes test Iraq's balancing act between Riyadh and Tehran
english: Recent joint air strikes by the United States and Saudi Arabia against Iran-affiliated militias in Iraq have complicated the Iraqi government’s efforts to maintain neutral relations with regional powers. These attacks were a direct response to drone strikes on Saudi oil infrastructure and serve as a warning to Tehran regarding its influence in the region. While both the militias and Saudi Arabia have indicated they prefer to avoid an ongoing conflict, the Iraqi government now faces immense pressure to manage its internal security while navigating these delicate diplomatic tensions.
amharic: በኢራቅ የሚገኙ ከኢራን ጋር ግንኙነት ያላቸው ታጣቂ ቡድኖች ላይ በአሜሪካ እና በሳውዲ አረቢያ በጋራ የተፈጸመው የአየር ጥቃት የኢራቅን መንግስት የውጭ ግንኙነት ሚዛን ጠብቆ ለመጓዝ የሚያደርገውን ጥረት ፈታኝ አድርጎታል። ይህ ጥቃት በሳውዲ የነዳጅ ማዕከላት ላይ ለተፈጸመው የድሮን ጥቃት ምላሽ የነበረ ሲሆን ለኢራን ጠንካራ ማስጠንቀቂያ ለመስጠት ያለመ ነው። ምንም እንኳን ሁለቱም ወገኖች ግጭቱን ለማስፋት ፍላጎት ባይኖራቸውም፣ ኢራቅ አሁን በአገሪቱ ውስጥ ካሉ ታጣቂ ቡድኖች ጋር ባላት ውስብስብ ግንኙነት እና በክልሉ አገራት መካከል ያለውን ውጥረት ለማርገብ ከፍተኛ ጫና ውስጥ ወድቃለች።
oromo: Humni waraana Ameerikaafi Saudii Arabiyaa waliin ta'uun garee biyya Iraan deggeru kan Iraaq keessa jiran irratti haleellaa raawwataniin, mootummaan Iraaq hariiroo isaa kan biyyoota ollaa wajjin jiru madaaluuf yaaluu isaa kan ulfeesse ta'eera. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame dhaabbata boba'aa Saudii irratti haleellaa xiyyaaraa kanaan dura raawwatameef deebii kennuufi akkasumas biyya Iraan akeekkachiisuufi. Garuunni sunis ta'e Saudii Arabiyaan walitti bu'iinsa bal'aa irraa of qusachuuf kan yaalan ta'us, mootummaan Iraaq amma nageenya biyya keessaa eeggachuufi hariiroo dippilomaasii kana madaaluuf rakkoo guddaa keessa galeera.

title: More than 150 migrants rescued after boat catches fire in Channel
english: Over 150 migrants were rescued on Tuesday after their boat caught fire while attempting to cross the English Channel to the UK. Although the passengers initially refused help from French authorities overnight, emergency teams from both France and Britain intervened once the vessel's condition worsened. Fortunately, all 157 individuals were safely recovered and are being transported to a port in France, with no casualties reported.
amharic: ከ150 በላይ ስደተኞች ወደ እንግሊዝ በጀልባ ሲሻገሩ ሳለ የያዙት ጀልባ በእሳት በመያዙ ምክንያት ማክሰኞ ዕለት ታድገዋል። ስደተኞቹ መጀመሪያ ላይ የፈረንሳይ ባለስልጣናት ያቀረቡትን የእርዳታ ጥሪ አልቀበልም ቢሉም፣ ጀልባዋ በአደጋ ላይ ስትወድቅ የፈረንሳይ እና የብሪታንያ የነፍስ አድን ቡድኖች ጣልቃ በመግባት አድነዋቸዋል። በድምሩ 157 ሰዎች ከጉዳት በደህና መትረፋቸው የተረጋገጠ ሲሆን፣ በአሁኑ ሰዓት ሁሉም ወደ ፈረንሳይ ወደብ እየተወሰዱ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Namoonni godaantota ta'an 150 ol ta'an, doonii gara UK deemutti jirtu keessatti ibidda ka'een booda Kibxata ganama oolaniiru. Godaantonni kun yeroo jalqabaa gargaarsa humnoota Faransaayi dhiyeessan fudhachuu didanii kan turan ta'us, doonittiin erga miidhamtee booda gareen fayyisaa Faransaayiifi Biritaaniyaa harka galchuun isaan oolchuuf dirqamaniiru. Namoonni 157 kun hundi miidhaan irra osoo hin ga'in nageenyaan kan fayyan yoo ta'u, amma gara buufata Faransaayiitti geessamaa jiru.

title: What will happen when a SpaceX rocket collides with the Moon?
english: A discarded upper stage of a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket is expected to crash into the Moon's surface this Wednesday. Experts confirm the event poses no threat to Earth and will likely create a new crater over 17 meters wide near the Einstein Crater. Scientists view this collision as a unique research opportunity to study the impact site, adding to the Moon's long history of crater formation.
amharic: የስፔስ ኤክስ ፋልኮን 9 ሮኬት ክፍል በሆነው አንድ ቁራጭ በዚህ ረቡዕ ጨረቃ ላይ እንደሚጋጭ ተገምቷል። ሳይንቲስቶች ይህ ክስተት በምድር ላይ ምንም አይነት አደጋ እንደማይፈጥር እና በአይንስታይን ክሬተር አቅራቢያ ከ17 ሜትር በላይ ስፋት ያለው ጉድጓድ እንደሚፈጥር ገልጸዋል። ባለሙያዎች ይህንን ግጭት ጨረቃን በቅርበት ለመመልከት እና ተፅእኖዋን ለማጥናት እንደ ጥሩ አጋጣሚ እየተመለከቱት ነው።
oromo: Kutaan rookeetii SpaceX Falcon 9 kan duraan gadi dhiifame tokko roobi dhufu kana gara ji'atti akka gatu eegama. Ogeeyyonni akka jedhanitti, taateen kun lafarra balaa kan hin geessisne yoo ta'u, naannoo Einstein Crater jedhamutti boolla bal'ina meetira 17 ol ta'e akka uumu ibsameera. Saayintistoonni walitti bu'iinsa kana akka carraa gaarii tokkootti ilaaluun, lafa ji'aa irratti jijjiirama uumamu qorachuuf itti fayyadamu.

title: Why Trump Media's sale of fast access to market-moving social posts is controversial
english: Trump Media has introduced a paid service called Truth API that offers financial firms ultra-fast access to influential social media posts on Truth Social. By allowing traders to react to market-moving statements in milliseconds, the company aims to generate revenue for its struggling business. This decision has sparked significant debate regarding ethics and potential conflicts of interest, as the former president holds a majority stake in the company profiting from his own public comments.
amharic: ትራምፕ ሚዲያ 'ትሩዝ ኤፒአይ' የተባለ አዲስ የክፍያ አገልግሎት የጀመረ ሲሆን ይህም የፋይናንስ ተቋማት በትሩዝ ሶሻል ላይ የሚለቀቁ ተፅዕኖ ፈጣሪ መረጃዎችን እጅግ በፍጥነት እንዲያገኙ የሚያስችል ነው። ኩባንያው ገቢ ለማግኘት ያለመ ቢሆንም፣ የቀድሞው ፕሬዚዳንት በኩባንያው ውስጥ ከፍተኛ ድርሻ እያላቸው በራሳቸው ንግግሮች ገንዘብ ማግኘታቸው የስነ-ምግባር ጥያቄዎችን አስነስቷል። ተገበያዮች እነዚህን መረጃዎች በሰከንዶች ውስጥ በመጠቀም የገበያ እንቅስቃሴን ለመቆጣጠር ስለሚጠቀሙበት፣ ጉዳዩ የህግ እና የፍትሃዊነት ክርክሮችን እየጋበዘ ይገኛል።
oromo: Trump Media tajaajila kaffaltii qabu kan 'Truth API' jedhamu kan eegale yoo ta'u, kunis dhaabbilee faayinaansii fi daldaltootaaf oduuwwan gurguddoo Truth Social irra jiran saffisaan argachuu dandeessisa. Tajaajilli kun dhaabbata faayidaa argachuu dadhabeef galii argamsiisuuf kan yaadame yoo ta'u, garuu gochi kun gaaffiiwwan amala gaarii fi walitti bu'iinsa faayidaa kaaseera. Sababni isaas, dura ta'aan kun qooda guddaa qabaachuu isaatiin ibsa ofii isaatiin gabaa irratti dhiibbaa uumee akka fayyadamu waan ta'eef, kunis seeraa fi haqa irratti mormii guddaa uumee jira.

title: Why Israel’s economy hasn’t collapsed during a multi-front war
english: Despite being involved in an ongoing multi-front war, Israel’s economy has remained remarkably resilient. The nation has successfully continued to draw significant foreign investments while maintaining the stability and strength of its currency. This economic endurance has surprised many observers given the high costs and disruptions typically associated with prolonged military conflicts.
amharic: እስራኤል በበርካታ ግንባሮች ጦርነት ውስጥ ብትሆንም፣ ኢኮኖሚዋ ግን ሳይናወጥ መቀጠሉ አስገራሚ ሆኗል። አገሪቱ ከፍተኛ መጠን ያለው የውጭ ኢንቨስትመንት መሳብ የቻለች ሲሆን የገንዘቧም ዋጋ ጠንካራ ሆኖ መቆየቱን ችላለች። ይህም ረጅም ጊዜ የሚፈጅ ጦርነት የሚያስከትለውን የኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ በመቋቋም በብዙዎች ዘንድ ትኩረትን ስቧል።
oromo: Israa'el gammoojjii hedduu keessatti waraana irratti bobbaatee kan jirtu ta'us, diinagdeen ishee garuu hin kufne. Biyyi kun invastimantii alaa hedduu harkisuu fi gatiin maallaqa ishee cimaa ta'ee akka itti fufu taasisuu dandeesseetti. Kunuun diinagdee kun waraana dheeraa fi rakkoolee diinagdee walitti fufan akka malee dammamee mul'atuun namoota hedduu dinqisiiseera.

title: Misread as passive, the Gulf is quietly ending fifty years of dependence
english: The recent conflict between Iran and the Gulf nations has highlighted that relying on outside security guarantees is no longer sustainable. Instead of seeking another foreign security umbrella, Gulf states are shifting toward building their own internal defense systems to ensure regional stability. This move represents a strategic effort to move away from fifty years of dependency and secure vital infrastructure against ongoing regional threats.
amharic: በኢራን እና በባህረ ሰላጤው አገራት መካከል የተፈጠረው የቅርብ ጊዜ ግጭት፣ በውጭ ኃይሎች የደህንነት ዋስትና ላይ መተማመን እንደማያዋጣ አሳይቷል። የባህረ ሰላጤው አገራት በሌላ የውጭ ጥበቃ ከመታመን ይልቅ፣ የክልሉን ሰላም ለማስጠበቅ የራሳቸውን የመከላከያ አቅም ለመገንባት እየተንቀሳቀሱ ነው። ይህ እርምጃ አገራቱ ላለፉት ሃምሳ ዓመታት ሲከተሉት የነበረውን ጥገኝነት በማስወገድ፣ ወሳኝ መሠረተ ልማቶቻቸውን ከክልላዊ ስጋቶች ለመከላከል ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Gurgurtoowwan Iran fi biyyoota Gulf gidduutti uumame akka mirkaneessetti, nageenya ofii eeggachuuf humnoota alaa irratti hirkachuun furmaata miti. Biyyoonni Gulf kun gargaarsa humna alaa biraa barbaaduu mannaa, nageenya naannoo isaanii mirkaneessuuf sirna ittisaa mataa isaanii ijaarrachuu jalqabaniiru. Tarkaanfin kun waggoota shantama darban keessa turan hirkattummaa xiqqeessuufi bu'uuraalee misoomaa isaanii sodaalee naannoo irraa ittisuuf kan karoorfame dha.

title: Who is behind settler violence in the occupied West Bank?
english: Extremist settler groups in the occupied West Bank are intensifying attacks against Palestinians to seize land and force residents out. Guided by hard-line nationalist and religious ideologies, these groups work to expand illegal settlements and prevent any future political peace processes. They operate with support from political and legal networks that allow them to use settlement outposts as bases for their violent activities.
amharic: በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አካባቢ የሚንቀሳቀሱ የጽንፈኛ ሰፋሪዎች ቡድን መሬትን ለመቆጣጠር እና ፍልስጤማውያንን ለመፈናቀል በየጊዜው ጥቃት እየፈጸሙ ይገኛሉ። እነዚህ ቡድኖች በጠንካራ ሃይማኖታዊ እና ብሔርተኛ አስተሳሰብ በመመራት ህገ-ወጥ ሰፈራዎችን ለማስፋፋት እና ማንኛውንም የሰላም ሂደት ለማደናቀፍ ይሰራሉ። እንቅስቃሴያቸውም በፖለቲካዊ እና ህጋዊ ድጋፍ የተደገፈ በመሆኑ፣ ሰፈራዎቹን ለጥቃት መነሻነት እንዲጠቀሙበት እድል ሰጥቷቸዋል።
oromo: Gareen gahuudotaa fiixa-biraa kanneen naannoo weerarame West Bank keessatti argaman, lafa qabachuu fi Palestinoota buqqisuuf jecha weerara irratti raawwachaa jiru. Gareen kun ilaalcha amantii fi biyyaalessummaa cimaa hordofaa, babal'ina qophiiwwan seeraan alaa fi adeemsa nagaa kamiyyuu gufachiisuuf hojjatu. Hojiin isaanii kun deeggarsa siyaasaa fi seeraa waan qabuuf, qophiiwwan isaan ijaaran kunneen akka buufata weeraraatti fayyadamuuf isaan gargaaraa jira.

title: ‘One last chance’: The times Trump threatened Iran, said deal imminent
english: US President Donald Trump has repeatedly threatened Iran with military action while simultaneously claiming a peace deal is imminent. Despite setting strict deadlines and issuing dire warnings, Trump has consistently backed down from these threats at the last minute. Meanwhile, Iran denies engaging in direct negotiations with the US, leaving the ongoing conflict unresolved after 23 weeks.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ኢራንን በወታደራዊ እርምጃ በተደጋጋሚ በማስፈራራት የሰላም ስምምነት ሊደረግ እንደሚችል በተደጋጋሚ ሲናገሩ ቆይተዋል። ትራምፕ ግልጽ የጊዜ ገደቦችን አስቀምጠው ከባድ ማስጠንቀቂያዎችን ቢሰጡም፣ በየጊዜው በወሰዷቸው እርምጃዎች ከመጨረሻው ሰዓት ላይ ከማስፈራሪያቸው ወደ ኋላ ሲሉ ታይተዋል። በሌላ በኩል ኢራን ከአሜሪካ ጋር ቀጥተኛ ድርድር እንደሌላት በመግለጿ፣ ላለፉት 23 ሳምንታት የዘለቀው ግጭት አሁንም መፍትሄ ሳይበጅለት ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Pirezedantiin Ameerikaa Doonaald Tiraamp Iran irratti tarkaanfii waraanaa fudhachuu sodaachisaa akkasumas waliigalteen nageenyaa dhihoo akka jiru irra deddeebi'anii ibsaa turaniiru. Tiraamp yeroo murtaa'aa kaa'uun akeekkachiisa cimaa kennanis, daqiiqaa dhumaarratti yaada isaanii jijjiiruun sodaachisa isaanii irraa duubatti jedhu. Gama biraatiin, Iran Ameerikaa waliin marii kallattii hin qabnu jechuun waan haalteef, waraanni torbee 23f itti fufe kun furmaata utuu hin argatin itti fufeera.

title: Italy suspends free movement with Spain: Is Schengen in crisis after Ceuta?
english: Italy has temporarily reinstated border controls for travelers arriving from Spain following a massive influx of migrants into the Spanish enclave of Ceuta. Experts clarify that Italy is not exiting the Schengen Agreement, but is instead using a common legal provision that allows member states to implement temporary checks. This decision is seen largely as a political move, as Italy and Spain do not share a land border, meaning the impact on travel is limited to air and sea routes.
amharic: ጣሊያን በስፔን ሴኡታ ግዛት በደረሰው ከፍተኛ የስደተኞች ፍሰት ምክንያት ከስፔን ለሚመጡ ተጓዦች በጊዜያዊነት የድንበር ቁጥጥር መጀመሯን አስታውቃለች። ባለሙያዎች እንደገለጹት ይህ እርምጃ የሼንገን ስምምነትን ከመጣስ ይልቅ የአባል ሀገራት በድንገተኛ ጊዜ የሚጠቀሙበት ህጋዊ መብት ነው። ጣሊያን እና ስፔን የየብስ ድንበር ስለሌላቸው ይህ ውሳኔ በአብዛኛው በአየር እና በባህር ጉዞ ላይ ብቻ የሚያተኩር የፖለቲካ እርምጃ እንደሆነ ይታመናል።
oromo: Xaliyaan baqattoota miliyoonatti lakkaa'aman gara lafa Speen kan taate Se'uutatti seenuun hordofee, namoota Speen irraa gara Xaliyaan deeman irratti to'annoo daangaa yeroo kaa'uuf murteessiteetti. Ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti, tarkaanfiin kun walii galtee Sheengen kan cabsu utuu hin taane, biyyoonni miseensa ta'an yeroo barbaachisaa ta'eetti itti fayyadamuu kan danda'an mirga seera qabeessa dha. Xaliyaan fi Speen daangaa lafaa walitti hin qabne waan ta'eef, murteen kun qilleensaan fi galaanaan imaltuu irratti kan daangeffameefi akka tarkaanfii siyaasaatti kan ilaalamu dha.

title: Lebanon and Israel hold new round of direct talks in Rome
english: Lebanese and Israeli officials have met in Rome for another series of US-mediated discussions regarding the withdrawal of Israeli forces from southern Lebanon. These talks build on a prior framework that proposed replacing militants with the Lebanese national army, a plan previously opposed by Hezbollah. Despite the ongoing negotiations, Hezbollah leadership has publicly dismissed these efforts as harmful to the nation's interests.
amharic: የሊባኖስ እና የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት የእስራኤል ወታደሮች ከደቡብ ሊባኖስ እንዲወጡ በዩናይትድ ስቴትስ አደራዳሪነት በሮም ተገናኝተዋል። እነዚህ ድርድሮች ቀደም ሲል የቀረበውን የሊባኖስ ብሄራዊ ጦር በደቡባዊ አካባቢዎች እንዲሰማራ የሚያደርግ እቅድ መሰረት ያደረጉ ናቸው። ሆኖም፣ የሂዝቦላህ አመራሮች እነዚህን ድርድሮች ሀገሪቱን የሚጎዱ እና ውርደትን የሚያስከትሉ ናቸው ሲሉ ተቃውመዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Libaanoos fi Israa'el loltoonni Israa'el kibba Libaanoos irraa akka bahaniif marii Ameerikaan giddu galeessa taateen Roomitti jalqabaniiru. Mariin kun kanaan dura qophii loltoota biyyoolessa Libaanoos naannichatti bobbaasuuf karoorfamee ture irratti hundaa'a. Haa ta'u malee, hogganoonni Hizbullaah mariin kun biyyattii irratti miidhaa fi salphina kan fidu ta'uu ibsuun mormaniiru.

title: How Morocco's Gaza deployment is reshaping its ties with Israel
english: Morocco has become the first Arab and African nation to send military personnel to the International Stabilisation Force in Gaza as part of a U.S.-led peace initiative. By deploying 200 soldiers, the Moroccan government aims to strengthen its diplomatic influence in the region and fulfill its duties under the Board of Peace. However, the mission faces significant uncertainty as Israel continues to expand its settlements and has not agreed to a withdrawal timeline, despite the move being framed by Rabat as a commitment to peace and humanitarian aid.
amharic: ሞሮኮ በአሜሪካ የሚመራው የሰላም ዕቅድ አካል በመሆን ወደ ጋዛ የሰላም አስከባሪ ወታደሮችን የላከች የመጀመሪያው የአረብ እና የአፍሪካ ሀገር ሆናለች። የሞሮኮ መንግስት 200 ወታደሮችን በመላክ በክልሉ ያለውን ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ተጽዕኖ ለማጠናከር እና የሰላም ቦርድ አባልነቱን ግዴታ ለመወጣት ያለመ ቢሆንም፣ እስራኤል ህገ-ወጥ ሰፈራዋን እያስፋፋች በመሆኑ የዚህ ተልዕኮ ውጤታማነት አጠያያቂ ሆኗል። ራባት ይህን እርምጃ ለሰላም እና ለሰብአዊ ድጋፍ የገባችው ቃል እንደሆነ ብትገልጽም፣ እስራኤል ከጋዛ የመውጣት እቅድ አለማሳየቷ ሁኔታውን አወሳስቦታል።
oromo: Morookoon sagantaa nagaa kan Ameerikaan hoogganamu keessatti hirmaachuun, waraana ishee gara Gaazaatti erguun biyya Arabaa fi Afrikaa jalqabaa taateetti. Mootummaan Morookoo waraana 200 erguun isaa dhiibbaa diippilomaasii isaa naannichatti cimsachuu fi dirqama 'Boordii Nagaa' (Board of Peace) keessatti qabu bahuuf kan karoorfame ta'us, Israa'el qubsuma seera-malee babal'isuu ishee fi iddoo sanaa gadi lakkisuuf fedhii waan hin argisiifneef, ergichi bu'aa qabaachuu isaa shakkiin keessa galeera. Raabaatin tarkaanfii kana nagaa fi gargaarsa namoomaaf akka ta'e ibsituus, Israa'el dhiisuuf waadaa hin galin jiruun haalli kun rakkoo cimaa keessa jira.

title: Video: Israeli settlers attack homes and burn cars in West Bank
english: Israeli settlers recently invaded the Palestinian villages of Talfit and Jalud, situated in the southern Nablus region of the West Bank. During the raid, they set fire to three vehicles and caused damage to several residential homes. Local sources reported these violent attacks as part of ongoing tensions in the occupied territory.
amharic: የእስራኤል ሰፈራ ነዋሪዎች በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ናብሉስ ግዛት በሚገኙት ታሊፊት እና ጃሉድ በተባሉ የፍልስጤም መንደሮች ላይ ጥቃት ፈጽመዋል። በዚሁ ጥቃት ወቅት ሶስት ተሽከርካሪዎችን በእሳት ያቃጠሉ ሲሆን የመኖሪያ ቤቶች ላይም ጉዳት አድርሰዋል። ይህ ክስተት በክልሉ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የጸጥታ መደፍረስ የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Buqqaattoonni Israa'el naannoo Qarxii (West Bank) keessatti, baadiyyaa Falasxiin kan ta'an Talfiit fi Jaaluud irratti weerara gaggeessaniiru. Weerara kanaan konkolaattoota sadii gubanii, manneen jireenyaa irrattis miidhaa geessisaniiru. Gochi kun walitti bu'iinsa naannichatti hammaataa jiru kan ibsuudha.

title: Qatar says US-Iran talks are 'ongoing'
english: Qatar has announced that diplomatic efforts to mediate between the United States and Iran are continuing despite conflicting reports. While President Trump mentioned that discussions are currently active, Iranian officials have denied any scheduled meetings. Qatar remains focused on encouraging both nations to return to the negotiating table to find a peaceful resolution.
amharic: በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል ያለው የዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት ግራ የሚያጋባ ቢሆንም፣ ሂደቱ አሁንም መቀጠሉን ኳታር አስታውቃለች። ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ንግግሮች እየተካሄዱ መሆናቸውን ቢናገሩም፣ የኢራን ባለስልጣናት ግን ምንም አይነት ቀጠሮ እንደሌለ ገልጸዋል። ኳታር በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ሰላማዊ መፍትሄ ለማምጣት ንግግሩ እንዲቀጥል ጥረቷን አጠናክራ ቀጥላለች።
oromo: Qatar, haasaa fi mariin gidduu Ameerikaa fi Iraan jiru akka itti fufuuf carraaqqii gochaa akka jirtu beeksisiteetti. Preezidaantiin Ameerikaa mariin akka jiru dubbatanis, mootummaan Iraan garuu mariin kamiyyuu akka hin jirre ibseera. Qatar waldhabdee kana furuuf gamtaan lameen gara mariitti akka deebi'an jajjabeessaa jirti.

title: Yemen's Houthis say they hit airport in Saudi Arabia
english: Houthi rebels in Yemen have claimed responsibility for launching an attack against an airport located in the southern Saudi Arabian city of Najran. The group made this announcement through their official Telegram channel. However, Saudi officials have not yet verified or commented on whether the strike actually took place.
amharic: በየመን የሚገኙት የሁቲ አማጽያን በደቡባዊ ሳዑዲ አረቢያ በሚገኘው የናጅራን አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ ላይ ጥቃት መፈጸማቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ቡድኑ ይህንን መረጃ በቴሌግራም ገጻቸው በኩል ይፋ አድርጓል። ይሁን እንጂ የሳዑዲ አረቢያ ባለስልጣናት ስለ ጥቃቱ እስካሁን ምንም አይነት ማረጋገጫ አልሰጡም።
oromo: Houthi kan Yaman keessa socho'an, buufata xiyyaaraa magaalattii Naajraan kan kibba Sa'udii Arabaatti argamu irratti haleellaa raawwachuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Gareen kun odeeffannoo kana karaa fuula Teleegraama isaanii ifa godhaniiru. Haa ta'u malee, mootummaan Sa'udii Arabaa haleellaa kana ilaalchisee hanga ammaatti ifatti waan tokko hin dubbanne.

title: Analysis: Trump challenged by cold reality from top allies
english: President Donald Trump is experiencing recent political and legal setbacks that have put him at odds with some of his most dedicated allies. A notable example is Attorney Jeanine Pirro, who recently dropped charges in a vandalism case after evidence proved the incident was an accident rather than a crime. Despite his team presenting factual evidence, the President continues to insist on his own version of events, further straining his relationships with his own administration.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በቅርቡ በተከሰቱ የፖለቲካ እና የሕግ ችግሮች የተነሳ ከቅርብ ደጋፊዎቻቸው ጋር አለመግባባት ውስጥ ገብተዋል። ለዚህም እንደ ማሳያነት የሚጠቀሰው የአሜሪካ ጠቅላይ ዓቃቤ ሕግ ጂኒን ፒሮ፣ አንድን የጥፋት ክስ ማስረጃው እንዳልተሟላ ሲረዱ መተው ነው። ትራምፕ በጉዳዩ ላይ ከተጨባጭ መረጃ ይልቅ በራሳቸው እምነት በመፅናታቸው፣ ከቅርብ አጋሮቻቸው ጋር ያላቸው ግንኙነት እየሻከረ መጥቷል።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Doolnaald Traamp rakkoolee siyaasaa fi seeraa mudataniin kan ka'e, deggertoota isaanii kan durii waliin wal dhabuun irra ga'eera. Fakkeenyaaf, abbaan alangaa Jiiniin Piiroo ragaan seeraa waan hin jirreef himata yakka irratti dhihaate tokko akka kaafamu gochuun isaanii pirezidaanticha aarseera. Traamp ragaa qabatamaa dhihaateef fudhachuu diduun yaada isaanii irratti waan cichaniif, michoota isaanii waliin walitti bu'iinsi uumameera.

title: Five dead in Moscow region as Ukraine continues warehouse strikes
english: A Ukrainian drone strike on a warehouse near Moscow resulted in five deaths and ten injuries. Ukraine asserts these facilities, often linked to the e-commerce giant Wildberries, are being utilized for Russian military logistics, though Moscow denies this claim. Simultaneously, Russian retaliatory strikes across various Ukrainian regions left at least four people dead and caused significant damage to residential areas.
amharic: ሞስኮ አቅራቢያ በሚገኝ መጋዘን ላይ በዩክሬን በተሰነዘረ የድሮን ጥቃት አምስት ሰዎች ሲሞቱ አስር ሰዎች ቆስለዋል። ዩክሬን እነዚህ የንግድ ማዕከላት ለሩሲያ ወታደራዊ አገልግሎት እንደሚውሉ ብትገልጽም፣ ሞስኮ ይህንን አስተባብላለች። በተመሳሳይ ጊዜ ሩሲያ በዩክሬን በተለያዩ አካባቢዎች በወሰደችው የአጸፋ እርምጃ ቢያንስ አራት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል።
oromo: Humni waraana Yukreen magaalaa Moskoo cinaatti buufata meeshaan itti kuufamu irratti erga xiyyaara malee (drone) qindeessiteen namoonni shan yoo du'an, kudhan immoo miidhamaniiru. Yukreen buufatni kun tajaajila waraanaaf oola jettee kan himattu yoo ta'u, Moskoon garuu himannaa kana haaltu. Hima kana hordofee, Raashiyaan guutuu Yukreen keessatti haleellaa deebisteen namoonni afur du'uu fi miidhaan biroos gahuun ibsameera.

title: US arrests suspect over Spokane wildfire as tens of thousands flee blaze
english: Authorities in Washington state have arrested a 37-year-old man for allegedly starting one of several massive wildfires near Spokane. The fires have destroyed hundreds of homes and forced approximately 65,000 residents to evacuate their neighborhoods. Experts attribute the increased severity of these blazes to climate change, which has caused prolonged drought conditions throughout the region.
amharic: በዋሽንግተን ግዛት ባለሥልጣናት ስፖኬን በተባለችው ከተማ አቅራቢያ በተነሱ በርካታ የሰደድ እሳት አደጋዎች ተጠርጣሪ የሆነን የ37 ዓመት ግለሰብ በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። የእሳት አደጋው በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ቤቶችን በማውደሙ ወደ 65 ሺህ የሚጠጉ ነዋሪዎች ከቀያቸው እንዲፈናቀሉ ተደርጓል። ባለሙያዎች እንደሚናገሩት፣ በአካባቢው እየተከሰተ ያለው የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ እና የረጅም ጊዜ ድርቅ የእሳት አደጋው እንዲባባስ ምክንያት ሆኗል።
oromo: Hojjettoonni nageenyaa naannoo Washington namicha umriin isaa 37 ta'e tokko, ibidda bosonaa magaalaa Spokane biratti ka'e keessatti harka qabaachuu isaatiin to'annoo jala oolchaniiru. ibiddayyuun kun mana hedduu barbadeessuun namoota 65,000 ol ta'an iddoo jireenya isaanii irraa akka godaanan dirqisiiseera. Ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti, jijjiiramni qilleensaa fi gogiinsi naannichatti mudate guddina ibidda kanaa hammaatutti geessiseera.

title: Nascimento: UFC fighter dead at 34 after apparent heart attack
english: UFC flyweight fighter Allan Nascimento has passed away at age 34 following an apparent heart attack while sleeping. The Brazilian athlete was discovered unresponsive in his home, and medical teams were unable to revive him. He is survived by his wife and two children, and the fighting community has expressed deep sadness over the loss of the talented competitor.
amharic: የዩኤፍሲው ተዋጊ አላን ናሲሜንቶ በእንቅልፍ ላይ እያለ ባጋጠመው ድንገተኛ የልብ ህመም በ34 ዓመቱ ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት ተለይቷል። ብራዚላዊው ተዋጊ በቤቱ ውስጥ ህይወቱ አልፎ የተገኘ ሲሆን፣ የህክምና ባለሙያዎች ለማትረፍ ያደረጉት ጥረት አልተሳካም። አላን ናሲሜንቶ ሚስት እና ሁለት ልጆችን ያፈራ የነበረ ሲሆን፣ የስፖርት ቤተሰቡ በድንገተኛ ሞቱ ከፍተኛ ሀዘን ተሰምቷቸዋል።
oromo: Qabsaa'aan UFC Allan Nascimento jedhamu, utuu hirriibaa jiruu tasa onnee isaatiin wal qabatee du'aan boqotee jira. Atileetichi lammii Biraazilii ta'e kun mana isaa keessatti utuu hin socho'in argame, gargaarsi fayyaa taasifameefis lubbuu isaa oolchuu hin dandeenye. Allan niitii fi ijoollee lama kan qabu yoo ta'u, du'a isaa kana ilaalchisee hawaasni ispoortii gadda guddaa ibsataa jira.

title: Palestine weekly: Israel kills dozens in Gaza after Hamas disarmament deal
english: Despite a recent US-brokered agreement aimed at disarming Hamas and advancing a ceasefire, intense Israeli military strikes have continued across Gaza. Hamas refuses to follow through on the deal until Israel withdraws its forces, while Israel insists on full disarmament first. This stalemate has led to a surge in violence, resulting in dozens of civilian deaths over the weekend and further destruction of essential infrastructure.
amharic: የሃማስን ትጥቅ ማስፈታት እና ተኩስ አቁም ስምምነትን ለማራመድ በአሜሪካ አደራዳሪነት የተደረገው ስምምነት ቢኖርም፣ እስራኤል በጋዛ ላይ የምታደርሰው ጥቃት ተባብሶ ቀጥሏል። ሃማስ እስራኤል ወታደሮቿን እስክታስወጣ ድረስ ስምምነቱን እንደማትቀበል ስትገልጽ፣ እስራኤል በበኩሏ ትጥቅ ሙሉ በሙሉ ሳይፈታ ጦሯን እንደማታስወጣ አሳውቃለች። በዚህ አለመግባባት ሳቢያ በተፈጠረ ውጥረት ባለፈው ሳምንት መጨረሻ ብቻ በደርዘን የሚቆጠሩ ንጹሃን ዜጎች ተገድለዋል፤ መሰረተ ልማቶችም ወድመዋል።
oromo: Hirmaannaa Ameerikaatiin waliigaltee dhaabbii waraanaa fi hiikkaa meeshaa waraanaa dhaabbata Hamaas irratti xiyyeeffatu erga godhamee booda, haleellaan Israa'el Gazaatti gaggeessitu daran hammaateera. Hamaas hanga waraanni Israa'el gadi ba'utti waliigaltee kana akka hin fudhanne ibsee, Israa'el gama isheetiin meeshaan waraanaa hanga guutummaatti hiikamutti waraana ishee akka hin baafne ibsiteetti. Waliigalteedhabdee kanaan kan ka'e, torbee darbe qofa namoonni hedduun du'aniiru, akkasumas bu'uuraalee misoomaa hedduun manca'aniiru.

title: US visa sanctions expose the limits of diplomatic pragmatism
english: The U.S. government's recent decision to impose visa sanctions on TPLF members is being criticized as a failure to prioritize justice following atrocities in Tigray. Critics argue that these measures prioritize political expediency over accountability and ignore the necessity of addressing genocide during peace processes. By sidelining the need for true reconciliation and justice, the U.S. risks undermining the long-term stability and dignity of the people affected by the conflict.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት በህወሓት አባላት ላይ የቪዛ ማዕቀብ መጣሉ፣ በትግራይ በተፈጸሙ ግፍዎች ላይ ፍትህን ለማስፈን ያለውን ቁርጠኝነት ጥያቄ ውስጥ እየከተተ ነው። ተቺዎች እንደሚሉት፣ ይህ እርምጃ የፖለቲካ ትርፍን ከፍትህ እና ከተጠያቂነት በላይ ያስቀደመ ነው። በእውነተኛ የዕርቅ ሂደት ላይ ትኩረት ባለማድረጉ፣ አሜሪካ በትግራይ ዘላቂ ሰላም እንዳይሰፍን እና የሰዎች ክብር እንዳይጠበቅ የማድረግ አደጋ ላይ ትገኛለች።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa miseensota ABO (TPLF) irratti tarkaanfii viizaa fudhachuun isaa, waldhabdee Tigraay keessatti yakka raawwatameef dhugaa fi haqni akka hin dhufne taasisaa jira jechuun qeeqamaa jira. Qeequun kun akka ibsutti, tarkaanfiin kun haqa irratti dursa kan kennuuf faayidaa siyaasaaf ta'uufi. Ameerikaan adeemsa nagaa fi araara dhugaa irratti xiyyeeffachuu dhiisuun ishee, nageenyi waaraan Tigraay keessatti akka hin argamne fi kabajni namummaa akka hin eegamne godha jechuun ibsamera.

title: EU calls for stronger borders after Ceuta migrant crossings
english: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen is calling for unified action to improve border security following a massive surge of migrants entering the Spanish territory of Ceuta from Morocco. While many migrants have since returned, the incident caused significant diplomatic tension, leading some EU nations to suggest suspending Spain from the Schengen area. EU officials are now planning emergency talks to develop a stronger, shared strategy for managing migration and protecting the bloc's external borders.
amharic: የአውሮፓ ህብረት ኮሚሽን ፕሬዝዳንት ኡርሱላ ቮን ደር ሌየን፣ በሞሮኮ በኩል በስፔን ግዛት በሲውታ በኩል በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ስደተኞች ከገቡ በኋላ የህብረቱን የድንበር ደህንነት ለማጠናከር አንድነት ያለው እርምጃ እንደሚያስፈልግ አስታውቀዋል። ምንም እንኳን አብዛኞቹ ስደተኞች ወደ መጡበት ቢመለሱም፣ ክስተቱ በአውሮፓ ህብረት አባል ሀገራት መካከል ውጥረት የፈጠረ ሲሆን ስፔንን ከሼንገን አካባቢ እንድትታገድ ጥያቄዎች ቀርበዋል። የህብረቱ መሪዎች የድንበር ጥበቃን ለማሻሻል እና ህገ-ወጥ ስደትን በጋራ ለመቆጣጠር በድንገተኛ ስብሰባ ለመወያየት አቅደዋል።
oromo: Pirezedantiin Komishinii Awurooppaa Ursula von der Leyen, godina Ispeen kan ta'e Si'uutaa keessatti godaantonni kumaan lakkaa'aman Morookoo irraa seenuun isaanii booda, nageenya daangaa cimsuuf tarkaanfii tokkoon tarkaanfachuu akka barbaachisu ibsaniiru. Godaantonni hedduun deebi'anii kan jiran ta'us, rakkoon kun biyyoota miseensa Gamtaa Awurooppaa gidduutti wal dhabdee kan uume yoo ta'u, biyyoonni tokko tokko Ispeen daangaa Schengen irraa akka dhaabattu gaafataniiru. Hogganoonni Gamtaichaa eegumsa daangaa fooyyessuufi godaantota seeraan alaa to'achuuf marii ariifachiisaa geggeessuuf karoorfataniiru.

title: Ariana Grande has had enough of body comments, but 'scrutiny' will linger
english: Pop star Ariana Grande has announced plans to step back from public life following years of persistent and invasive comments regarding her body and physical appearance. Despite the singer's previous efforts to encourage fans to stop focusing on her weight, the intense social media scrutiny has continued. Grande recently released a new album that addresses the pressures of fame, and she intends to take a well-deserved break once her current concert tour concludes.
amharic: ታዋቂዋ ድምጻዊት አሪያና ግራንዴ ስለ ሰውነቷ ቅርጽ ለዓመታት ሲሰነዘርባቸው የነበሩ አላስፈላጊ አስተያየቶች ሰልችተዋት ከሕዝብ እይታ ለመራቅ ወስናለች። አርቲስቷ ቀደም ሲል አድናቂዎቿ በአካል ብቃት ላይ ማተኮር እንዲያቆሙ ብትጠይቅም፣ በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ የሚሰነዘሩ ትችቶች ሳይቆሙ ቀጥለዋል። አሪያና ዝነኝነት የሚያመጣውን ጫና የሚገልጽ አዲስ አልበም ያወጣች ሲሆን፣ አሁን እያከናወነች ያለችው የሙዚቃ ጉብኝት እንደተጠናቀቀ ከሥራዋ እረፍት እንደምትወስድ አስታውቃለች።
oromo: アーティストのアリアナ・グランデは、自身の体型に関する長年の心ないコメントに疲れ、公の場から距離を置くことを発表しました。彼女は以前、ファンに対して体型に関する話題を控えるよう求めていましたが、SNS上での厳しい視線は収まりませんでした。グランデは名声の重圧をテーマにした新作アルバムをリリースしたばかりで、現在行っているツアーが終了次第、活動を一時休止する予定です。

title: France wildfires reveal hundreds of WW2 shells in village
english: A massive wildfire in the French village of Le Porge recently uncovered a hidden cache of roughly 400 unexploded shells and munitions dating back to World War Two. The intense heat caused these buried explosives to detonate, destroying numerous homes and sounding like a battlefield to local residents. Authorities have since cleared the area and allowed many people to return, though some dangerous zones remain restricted while cleanup operations continue.
amharic: በፈረንሳይ ሌ ፖርጅ መንደር የተነሳው ትልቅ የደን ቃጠሎ ከሁለተኛው የዓለም ጦርነት የተረፉ ከ400 በላይ ያልፈነዱ ፈንጂዎችን እና ጥይቶችን አጋልጧል። የቃጠሎው ከፍተኛ ሙቀት እነዚህን በአፈር ውስጥ ተቀብረው የነበሩ የጦር መሳሪያዎች እንዲፈነዱ በማድረጉ በርካታ ቤቶች ወድመዋል። የደህንነት ባለስልጣናት አካባቢውን በማጽዳት ነዋሪዎች ወደ ቤታቸው እንዲመለሱ ቢፈቅዱም፣ አሁንም አንዳንድ አደገኛ ቦታዎች ለህዝብ ዝግ ሆነው ይገኛሉ።
oromo: ibidda bosonaa guddaa biyya Faransaay ganda Le Porge jedhamu keessatti ka’een, rasaasotaa fi meeshaalee waraanaa waraana addunyaa lammaffaa keessa turan 400 ol ta’an lafa keessaa ba’aniiru. Ho’i ibiddaa sun meeshaalee lafa jala turan kana waan fayyiseef, walitti aansuudhaan waan dhuka’aniif manni jireenyaa hedduun manca’aniiru. Aangeyyoonni naannichaa bakka sana erga qulqulleessanii booda namoonni baay’een mana isaaniitti akka deebi’an heyyamaniiru, ta’us bakkeewwan balaa qaban tokko tokko amma illee cufaa dha.

title: Why are the Washington wildfires so severe? Spokane fires explained
english: A series of intense wildfires near Spokane, Washington, have forced roughly 65,000 residents to evacuate their homes as the blaze spreads rapidly through residential areas. Driven by powerful winds and extremely dry vegetation, the fires have already destroyed hundreds of buildings and prompted a massive regional emergency response. Authorities are currently working to contain the flames and assess the full extent of the destruction while assisting displaced community members.
amharic: በዋሽንግተን ስቴት ስፖኬን ከተማ አቅራቢያ የተነሱ ኃይለኛ የእሳት ቃጠሎዎች ወደ መኖሪያ አካባቢዎች በመስፋፋታቸው ወደ 65,000 የሚጠጉ ነዋሪዎች ቤታቸውን ለቀው እንዲወጡ ተገደዋል። በደረቅ አየር እና በጠንካራ ንፋስ የተባባሰው እሳቱ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ቤቶችን እና ንብረቶችን አውድሟል። በአሁኑ ወቅት ከሺህ በላይ የእሳት አደጋ መከላከያ ሰራተኞች እሳቱን ለመቆጣጠር እየሰሩ ሲሆን፣ ባለስልጣናት የደረሰውን ሙሉ ጉዳት ለመለየት ጥረት በማድረግ ላይ ናቸው።
oromo: Magaalaa Spokane, Washingtonitti ibidda humna guddaa qabuun ka’een, namootni 65,000 ol ta’an manneen isaanii gadhiisanii ba’uun dirqameera. Qilleensa cimaa fi biqiltuu gogee jiruun kan babal’ate ibidni kun manneen hedduu barbadeessuu isaatiin malaan rakkoo guddaa uumeera. Ammaaf dhaabbileen mootummaa fi ogeeyyiin ibida dhaamsituu kuma tokkoo ol ta’an ibidicha to’achuuf socho’aa kan jiran yoo ta’u, miidhaa gahuu danda’e xiinxaluun itti fufee jira.

title: Bodycam video shows firefighters battling blaze in Spokane, US
english: Bodycam footage has captured the intense efforts of firefighters working to extinguish a fast-spreading wildfire near Spokane, Washington. The blaze has forced over 60,000 residents to evacuate their homes. Emergency crews have been battling the flames for three consecutive days to contain the situation.
amharic: በአሜሪካ ዋሽንግተን ግዛት ስፖካን አካባቢ በተነሳ ኃይለኛ የእሳት ቃጠሎ ወቅት የእሳት አደጋ ተከላካዮች እሳቱን ለማጥፋት የሚያደርጉት ጥረት በሰውነት ካሜራ ተቀድቷል። ይህ የእሳት አደጋ ከ60,000 በላይ ነዋሪዎችን ከመኖሪያ ቤታቸው እንዲፈናቀሉ አስገድዷል። የእሳት አደጋ ሠራተኞች ለሦስት ተከታታይ ቀናት እሳቱን ለመቆጣጠር ከፍተኛ ጥረት እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Viidiyoon kaameraa qaamaa irratti qabame, ibiddi guddaan magaalaa ispookeenii, Waashingitanitti mudate dhaamsiisuuf ogeeyyotni dhaamsaa ibiddaa hangam akka dadhaban agarsiisa. Ibiddi kun namoota 60,000 ol ta'an manasaanii gadhiisanii akka baqatan dirqisiiseera. Ogeeyyotni kun guyyoota sadan darban keessa ibidda kana dhaamsiisuuf tattaaffii cimaa gochaa jiru.

title: Colombia’s Petro repeats vote fraud claims days before handing over power
english: Outgoing Colombian President Gustavo Petro is claiming that the recent presidential election was rigged, despite official confirmation of his successor Abelardo de la Espriella’s victory. Petro alleges that digital vote tallies were manipulated and that the process lacked necessary transparency, though electoral authorities and international observers have dismissed these accusations. As the inauguration approaches, experts worry that these unsubstantiated claims could increase political division in the country.
amharic: የኮሎምቢያው ፕሬዝዳንት ጉስታቮ ፔትሮ ሥልጣናቸውን ከመልቀቃቸው ጥቂት ቀናት ቀደም ብሎ፣ በቅርቡ የተካሄደው ምርጫ የተጭበረበረ መሆኑን በመግለጽ የያሸናፊውን የአቤላርዶ ደ ላ ኤስፕሪዬላን ድል ተቃውመዋል። ፔትሮ የድምፅ መስጫ ወረቀቶች በዲጂታል መንገድ እንደተቀየሩ እና የምርጫ ሂደቱ ግልጽ እንዳልነበር ቢናገሩም፣ የምርጫ ባለስልጣናት እና ዓለም አቀፍ ታዛቢዎች ክሱ መሠረተ ቢስ መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ውዝግብ አዲሱ ፕሬዝዳንት ሥልጣን ከመረከባቸው በፊት በሀገሪቱ ያለውን የፖለቲካ መከፋፈል እንደሚያባብሰው ተሰግቷል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Kolombiyaa aangoo gadi lakkisuuf jedhan Gustaavo Peetroon, filannoo dhihoo kana gaggeeffame keessatti gowwoomsaan raawwatameera jechuun mo'annoo bakka bu'aa isaanii Aabeelaardoo de la Eespriyeellaa mormaniiru. Peetroon qulqulleessi sagalee dijitaalaan jijjiirameera fi adeemsichi ifa hin turre jechuun himatanis, abbootiin taayitaa filannoo fi hordoftoonni idil-addunyaa himannaa kana dhugummaa hin qabu jedhaniiru. Mootummaan haaraan aangoo fudhachuuf guyyoota muraasa hafan kanatti, himannaan kun biyyattii keessatti walqoodinsa siyaasaa daran akka hammaatu yaaddoo uumera.

title: Pochettino agrees to coach men’s US Soccer through 2030 World Cup
english: Mauricio Pochettino has officially signed on to lead the United States men's national soccer team for the next four years. This new agreement ensures he will remain as head coach through the 2030 World Cup. He previously guided the team to the round of 16 in the most recent tournament.
amharic: ሞሪሺዮ ፖቸቲኖ በሚቀጥሉት አራት ዓመታት የአሜሪካን የወንዶች ብሔራዊ የእግር ኳስ ቡድን በዋና አሰልጣኝነት ለመምራት ተስማምተዋል። ይህ ስምምነት እስከ 2030 የዓለም ዋንጫ ድረስ በቡድኑ ውስጥ እንዲቆዩ የሚያደርግ ነው። አሰልጣኙ ከዚህ ቀደም ቡድኑን በመጨረሻው የዓለም ዋንጫ እስከ ጥሎ ማለፍ ምዕራፍ ማድረስ ችለው ነበር።
oromo: Mauricio Pochettino waggoota afur dhufaniif garee kubbaa miilaa dhiirota Ameerikaa leenjisuuf waliigaltee mallatteesseera. Waliigalteen kun hanga Waancaa Addunyaa bara 2030tti leenjisaa ta'anii akka turan taasisa. Kanaan dura, tapha waancaa addunyaa darbe irratti garee kana hanga sadarkaa 16 gurguddootti geessuun isaanii ni yaadatama.

title: Pezeshkian says Iran not seeking a wider war
english: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian stated that while Iran remains committed to protecting its territory, the nation does not want to intensify regional conflicts. He emphasized that the country must focus on strengthening its social unity to resist outside threats and prevent instability. His remarks highlight a desire to avoid further military expansion while maintaining a defensive stance.
amharic: የኢራን ፕሬዝዳንት ማሱድ መዘሽኪያን አገራቸው ድንበሯን ለመጠበቅ ቁርጠኛ ብትሆንም፣ በክልሉ ውስጥ ያለውን ግጭት ለማባባስ እንደማትፈልግ አስታውቀዋል። የኢራን ህዝብ ውጫዊ ስጋቶችን ለመቋቋም እና አገሪቱን ለመጠበቅ በአንድነት ሊቆም እንደሚገባም አጽንኦት ሰጥተዋል። ይህ መግለጫ ኢራን ተጨማሪ ጦርነት ውስጥ ከመግባት ይልቅ የመከላከያ አቋሟን እንደምትከተል ያሳያል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Iraan Masuud Pezeshkian akka jedhanitti, Iraan daangaa ishee tiksuuf kan murteeffatte ta'us, waraana naannichaa babal'isuuf fedhii akka hin qabne ibsaniiru. Sabni Iraan miidhaa alaa ofirraa ittisuuf tokkummaan dhaabbachuu akka qabu dubbataniiru. Ibsi kun, Iraan waraana gara fuulduraa irraa of qusachuun of ittisuuf qofa akka xiyyeeffattu kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Israeli forces, settlers launch attacks against Palestinians in the West Bank
english: Israeli forces and settlers have conducted a series of violent attacks against Palestinians across various locations in the West Bank. These incidents involved the burning of homes, vehicles, and farmland, as well as the physical assault of local residents, including children. During these operations, Israeli military units used live ammunition and tear gas to suppress crowds while facilitating settler movements.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች እና ሰፋሪዎች በዌስት ባንክ በሚገኙ የተለያዩ አካባቢዎች በፓለስቲናውያን ላይ ተከታታይ ጥቃቶችን ፈጽመዋል። እነዚህ ድርጊቶች የቤቶችን፣ የተሽከርካሪዎችን እና የግብርና መሬቶችን ማቃጠል እንዲሁም ህጻናትን ጨምሮ በነዋሪዎች ላይ የሚደርስ አካላዊ ጥቃትን ያካትታሉ። በእነዚህ እንቅስቃሴዎች ወቅት የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ክፍሎች ሰፋሪዎችን ለመርዳት በሚል የቀጥታ ጥይቶችን እና የለቅሶ ጋዝ በመጠቀም በሰላማዊ ሰዎች ላይ ጉዳት አድርሰዋል።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el fi qonnaan bultoonni (settlers) naannoo West Bank garaa garaatti palastineerota irratti haleellaa cimaa gaggeessaa jiru. Haleellaa kanaan manni jireenyaa, konkolaattotni fi lafti qonnaa gubachuu akkasumas daa'imman dabalatee lammiileen hedduun miidhamaniiru. Humni waraanaa Israa'el adeemsa kana keessatti qonnaan bultoota deggeruuf jecha rasaasa dhukaasuu fi gaazii imimmaansisuu fayyadamuun uummata miidhuu gabaafameera.

title: Senior Iranian official says US will 'face serious risks and casualties' if naval blockade continues
english: A senior adviser to Iran's Supreme Leader has warned the United States that its continued naval blockade of Iranian ports will result in dangerous consequences for American personnel and ships. The official demanded a shift in U.S. policy, stating that Iran will not accept these restrictions or allow the creation of additional transit routes in the Strait of Hormuz. This threat signals a potential escalation in tensions between the two nations regarding maritime operations in the region.
amharic: የኢራን ጠቅላይ መሪ ከፍተኛ አማካሪ ሞህሰን ረዛኢ፣ አሜሪካ በኢራን ወደቦች ላይ የምታደርገውን የባህር ላይ እገዳ ካላቆመች በአሜሪካ የባህር ኃይል እና መርከቦች ላይ ከባድ ጉዳት እንደሚደርስ አስጠነቀቁ። ኢራን ይህንን የኃይል እርምጃ እንደማትታገስ የገለጹት አማካሪው፣ በሆርሙዝ የባህር ስርጥ ተጨማሪ የመተላለፊያ መንገዶች እንዲከፈቱ እንደማትፈቅድም አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ማስጠንቀቂያ በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ባለው የባህር ላይ ውጥረት መባባሱን ያሳያል።
oromo: Gorsaan olaanaan hoogganaa ol'aanaa Iraan, Mohsen Reza'ii, yoo Ameerikaan murtii dooniiwwan Iraan ugguruu ishee itti fufte, waraanaafi dooniiwwan ishee irratti balaa cimaatu mudata jechuun akeekkachiisaniiru. Iraan gocha kana akka hin danda'in fi hirmaannaa dabalataa kan akka banuu karaa biraa kan Hormuz keessatti fudhatamu akka hin hayyamne ibsaniiru. Akeekkachiisni kun walitti bu'iinsa biyyoota lamaan gidduutti gammoojjii galaanaa irratti jiru hammeenya akka argatu kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Netanyahu says he has ‘disagreements’ with Trump on  Gaza plan
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has openly admitted to having differences of opinion with President Donald Trump concerning the latest ceasefire deal with Hamas. Netanyahu insists that Gaza must be demilitarized and Hamas must lay down its weapons prior to any efforts to rebuild the region. These remarks were made following his consultation with the American peace envoy, Nickolay Mladenov.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ ከሃማስ ጋር በተደረሰው የቅርብ ጊዜ ስምምነት ላይ ከፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ጋር አለመግባባቶች እንዳሉ ገልጸዋል። ጋዛ እንደገና ከመገንባቷ በፊት ሃማስ ትጥቅ መፍታት እንዳለበት እና አካባቢው ከወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ ነጻ መሆን እንዳለበት ኔታንያሁ አሳስበዋል። ይህንኑ ሃሳብ የገለጹት ከአሜሪካው ሰላም አስከባሪ ልዑክ ኒኮላይ ምላደኖቭ ጋር ከተወያዩ በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Mummichi ministeera Israa'el Benyaamin Netaaniyaahuu waliigaltee haaraa haamaas waliin taasifame irratti pirezidaant Doonaald Tiraamp waliin walii galtee akka hin qabne ibsaniiru. Netaaniyaahuun, duraan haamaas meeshaa hiikkatee gaziin hamma waraana irraa bilisa ta'uu akka qabu, sana booda qofa dhaabbata haaraa ijaaruun akka danda'amu dubbataniiru. Yaada kana kan ibsanis ergaa nageenyaa Ameerikaa Nikoolay Mlaadanoov waliin erga mari'atanii booda.

title: Salvadoran man dies in ICE custody at New Jersey detention centre
english: Edwin Lopez-Cornejo, a 41-year-old Salvadoran man, recently passed away after suffering a medical emergency at the Delaney Hall detention center in New Jersey. His family and advocates claim he was denied necessary medication for his existing health conditions, though ICE asserts he received appropriate care. This incident, marking the second death at the facility in under a year, has led to public protests and renewed calls for the center to be closed.
amharic: ኤድዊን ሎፔዝ-ኮርኔጆ የተባሉ የ41 ዓመት የሳልቫዶር ተወላጅ በኒው ጀርሲ በሚገኘው የዴላኒ ሆል እስር ቤት በህክምና ድንገተኛ አደጋ ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ቤተሰቦቻቸው እና የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾች ለነበረባቸው የጤና እክል አስፈላጊውን መድሃኒት እንዳያገኙ ተደርገዋል በማለት የከሰሱ ሲሆን፣ የኢሚግሬሽን እና የጉምሩክ ማስፈጸሚያ ኤጀንሲ (ICE) ግን ተገቢውን ህክምና እንደተደረገላቸው ይናገራል። በአንድ ዓመት ጊዜ ውስጥ በተመሳሳይ እስር ቤት የሁለተኛው ሰው ህልፈት በመከሰቱ፣ ተቋሙ እንዲዘጋ የተቃውሞ ሰልፎች እየተካሄዱ ይገኛል።
oromo: Edwiin Looppez-Koorneeyoo kan jedhaman umriin isaanii waggaa 41 kan ta’e lammii Saalvaadoor, buufata qabii godaantotaa Deelaanii Haal kan Niiw Jeersii jiru keessatti rakkoo fayyaa mudateen du’aniiru. Maatiin isaanii fi gartuuwwan mirga namoomaa dhimmoota fayyaa isaan qaban irratti qorichi barbaachisu akka isaanitti hin geenye dubbatanis, qaamni ICE garuu walqixxummaa fi qulqullina qabuun yaalii akka godhameef hima. Golee kana keessatti waggaa tokko hin guunne keessatti lubbuun namoota lama darbuun isaa mormii uumee fi buufatichi akka cufamu gaaffiin akka ka’u taasiseera.

title: US stocks near record high, oil falls as Trump claims Iran talks under way
english: US stock markets saw a significant rally, with the Dow Jones reaching a new record high despite uncertainty regarding potential peace negotiations with Iran. While tech stocks led the market surge, oil prices dropped following claims by President Trump that talks between Washington and Tehran are underway. Investors remain cautious as the US and Iran offer conflicting reports about the current status of these diplomatic discussions.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የአክሲዮን ገበያ ከኢራን ጋር እየተደረገ ስላለው የሰላም ድርድር ባለው እርግጠኛ አለመሆን መሀል ከፍተኛ ጭማሪ አሳይቷል፣ በተለይም የዶው ጆንስ መረጃ ጠቋሚ አዲስ ክብረ ወሰን አስመዝግቧል። ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በዋሽንግተን እና በቴህራን መካከል ድርድር እየተካሄደ ነው ማለታቸውን ተከትሎ የነዳጅ ዋጋ ቀንሷል። ነገር ግን ሁለቱ ሀገራት ስለ ድርድሩ ሁኔታ የሚሰጡት መረጃ የሚጋጭ በመሆኑ ባለሀብቶች በጥንቃቄ እየተከታተሉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Gabaan aksiyoonaa Ameerikaa marii nagaa Iran waliin taasifamu irratti shakkiin jiraatuus, guddina olaanaa galmeessiseera; keessattuu Dow Jones rekodii haaraa qabateera. Preezdaant Traamp mariin gidduu Waashingitan fi Tehraanitti adeemsifamaa jiraachuu dubbachuun isaanii gatiin boba'aa akka hir'atu godheera. Haata'u malee, biyyoonni lameen waa'ee haala mariichaa gabaasa walfaallessu kennuun isaanii investaroonni akka of eeggannoon socho'an taasiseera.

title: Ibrahim Traore: Why Burkina Faso’s popular leader faces a reality test
english: Captain Ibrahim Traore, who seized power in Burkina Faso's 2022 coup, has gained fame across Africa for his stance on sovereignty and anti-imperialism. While he remains popular for his efforts to reduce foreign influence and promote self-reliance, his administration faces criticism for restricting political freedoms and failing to resolve the nation's ongoing security crisis. His decision to delay a return to democracy has raised concerns about the long-term impact of his military-led government on the country.
amharic: እ.ኤ.አ. በ2022 በተካሄደው መፈንቅለ መንግስት ስልጣን የያዙት ካፒቴን ኢብራሂም ትራኦሬ በሉዓላዊነት እና በፀረ-ኢምፔሪያሊዝም አቋማቸው በመላው አፍሪካ ተወዳጅነትን አትርፈዋል። የውጭ ተፅእኖን በመቀነስ እና የሀገር ውስጥ አቅምን በማጎልበት ረገድ ድጋፍ ቢኖራቸውም፣ መንግስታቸው የፖለቲካ ነፃነትን በመገደቡ እና የሀገሪቱን የጸጥታ ችግር መፍታት ባለመቻሉ እየተተቸ ነው። ወደ ዴሞክራሲያዊ ስርአት የሚደረገውን ሽግግር ማራዘማቸውም በመንግስታቸው የወደፊት እጣ ፈንታ ላይ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Kapiteen Ibraahim Traoree bara 2022 fonqolcha mootummaan aangoo kan qabatan yoo ta'u, waa'ee birmadummaa fi farra impaayeralizimii irratti qaban irratti hundaa'uun Afrikaa keessatti beekamtii argataniiru. Dhiibbaa alaa hir'isuuf yaalii godhaniin hordoftoota hedduu horatanis, mootummaan isaanii mirga siyaasaa daangessuu fi nageenya biyyattii mirkaneessuu dhabuun isaanii qeeqa irratti baneera. gara sirna dimokiraasii deebi'uu dabarsuun isaanii immoo gara fuulduraatti mootummaan waraanaa kun biyyattii irratti dhiibbaa akkamii akka qabaatu yaaddoo uumera.

title: Does the US blockade on Cuba make America safer?
english: The Trump administration has tightened economic restrictions on Cuba, justifying the move by labeling the country a persistent threat to U.S. national security. While the blockade remains controversial, some policy experts argue that Cuba’s highly capable intelligence services pose a legitimate risk to American interests. The administration continues to defend these escalated sanctions as a necessary measure for national protection.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት ኩባ ለብሄራዊ ደህንነታቸው ስጋት እንደሆነች በመግለጽ በሀገሪቱ ላይ የጣለውን የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ አጠናክሯል። አንዳንድ የፖሊሲ አማካሪዎች የኩባ የስለላ ተቋም ከፍተኛ አቅም ያለው በመሆኑ ለአሜሪካ ስጋት መሆኑን ይስማማሉ። መንግስት ይህንን ማዕቀብ ሀገሪቱን ለመከላከል አስፈላጊ እርምጃ እንደሆነ ይገልጻል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa biyyi Kuubaa nageenya biyyattiitiif sodaadha jechuun daangaa dinagdee irratti kaa'ame cimseera. Hayyoonni siyaasaa tokko tokko akka jedhanitti, tajaajilli odeeffannoo Kuubaa humna cimaa qabaachuun isaa Ameerikaaf yaaddoo ta'uu mala. Mootummaan tarkaanfii kana nageenya biyyaa eeguuf kan barbaachisuudha jedha.

title: Board of Peace says no Israeli withdrawal from Gaza before Hamas disarms
english: The U.S.-led Board of Peace has clarified that Israeli forces will not withdraw from Gaza until Hamas fully disarms, including the removal of all weapons and tunnels. Despite ongoing talks, Israeli officials have expressed dissatisfaction with the terms of the deal, while Hamas maintains that the agreement depends on Israel meeting its own obligations. Meanwhile, violence continues in the region, with reports of recent casualties despite previously established ceasefire efforts.
amharic: በአሜሪካ የሚመራው የሰላም ቦርድ የጋዛን አካባቢ ሙሉ በሙሉ ትጥቅ እስካልፈታ ድረስ የእስራኤል ወታደሮች ከጋዛ እንደማይወጡ አስታውቋል። የቦርዱ ዳይሬክተር ኒኮላይ ምላዴኖቭ ከጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ ጋር ከተወያዩ በኋላ፣ የሃማስ የጦር መሳሪያዎች እና ዋሻዎች ሙሉ በሙሉ እስኪወገዱ ድረስ መውጣቱ እንደማይከናወን ገልጸዋል። በሌላ በኩል ሀማስ ስምምነቱ ተግባራዊ የሚሆነው እስራኤል የገቡትን ቃል ሲፈጽሙ ብቻ እንደሆነ አቋሙን ይዟል።
oromo: Boordiin Nageenyaa kan Ameerikaan durfamu, humnoonni Israa'el hamma dhaabbanni Hamaas meeshaa waraanaa guutuu hiikkatuufi tunnela isaa diiguutti, Gaza keessaa akka hin baane ibseera. Qajeelchi boordichaa Nikoolay Mlaadeenoov pirezidaant Binyaamiin Netaanyaahuu waliin mari'achuu isaanii hordofee, kaayyoon inni guddaan bulchiinsa sivilii uumuu akka ta'e beeksise. Gama biraatiin, Hamaas waliigalteen kun kan hojiirra oolu Israa'el dirqama ishee yoo baatte qofa akka ta'e ibsee jira.

title: Report: Pentagon is emailing military experts and asking best way to 'punish' Iran
english: The U.S. military is actively seeking advice from external experts to develop new strategies for pressuring Iran. This initiative, revealed through internal communications, suggests that the Pentagon is struggling to find a resolution to the ongoing tensions. While officials claim such inquiries are routine, the effort highlights the administration's difficulty in achieving its desired diplomatic goals with Tehran.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ መሥሪያ ቤት በኢራን ላይ ጫና የሚፈጥሩባቸውን አዳዲስ መንገዶች ለመቀየስ ከውጭ ባለሙያዎች ምክር እየጠየቀ ይገኛል። በወጡ መረጃዎች መሰረት፣ ፔንታጎን አሁን ያለውን የኢራን ውጥረት ለመፍታት አዳጋች እንደሆነበት ይታያል። ምንም እንኳን ባለስልጣናት ይህ የተለመደ አሰራር ነው ቢሉም፣ ድርጊቱ አስተዳደሩ ከኢራን ጋር የፈለገውን ስምምነት ላይ ለመድረስ እየተቸገረ መሆኑን ያሳያል።
oromo: Raayyaan ittisa biyya Ameerikaa dhiibbaa Iran irratti uumuuf mala haaraa barbaadaa jiraachuu gabaasni tokko ifa godheera. Pentagonin rakkoo Iran wajjiin jiru furuuf gargaarsa ogeeyyota alaa gaafachuun isaa, mootummaan Trump rakkoo kana keessaa ba'uuf akka dhiphachaa jiru mul'isa. Qondaaltonni tarkaanfichi kan barame dha jedhanii ibsanis, kun ammoo Ameerikaan fedhii ishee Iran biratti guuttachuuf akka rakkachaa jirtu agarsiisa.

title: UKMTO says tank struck off Oman's coast
english: A cargo ship was hit by an unidentified object while traveling near the coast of Oman in the Strait of Hormuz. The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations reported that the incident occurred approximately 20 nautical miles from Al Khasab. Authorities are currently investigating the circumstances surrounding the strike on the vessel.
amharic: በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት በኦማን የባህር ዳርቻ አቅራቢያ የሚጓዝ የካርጎ መርከብ ባልታወቀ ነገር ተመታ። የዩናይትድ ኪንግደም የባህር ንግድ ኦፕሬሽን እንደገለጸው፣ ጥቃቱ የተፈፀመው ከአል ካሳብ 20 የባህር ማይል ርቀት ላይ ነው። ባለሥልጣናት በመርከቧ ላይ ስለደረሰው ጥቃት ምርመራ እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Markabii fe'umsaa tokko naannoo garba Oomaan, Handhuura Hormuzitti imalaa osoo jiruu waan hin beekamneen rukutame. Dhaabbanni Daldala Galaana UK ibsa baaseen, miidhaan kun kan ga'e magaalaa Al-Khaasaab irraa fageenya maayila galaana 20 irratti akka ta'e beeksiseera. Abbootiin taayitaa dhimma miidhaa markabii kanaa irratti qorannoo geggeessaa jiru.

title: Iran war live: Tehran denies US talks as Trump warns of ‘last chance’
english: President Donald Trump has claimed that negotiations are currently taking place with Iran, describing these discussions as a final opportunity to resolve the ongoing five-month conflict. However, Iranian officials have officially rejected this statement, clarifying that they are only in dialogue with Oman regarding maritime safety in the Strait of Hormuz. The situation remains tense as both sides present conflicting accounts of potential diplomatic progress.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከአይራን ጋር ድርድር እየተካሄደ መሆኑን በመግለጽ ይህ የአይራን የመጨረሻ ዕድል እንደሆነ አስታውቀዋል። ይሁን እንጂ የኢራን ባለስልጣናት ይህንን የትራምፕ ንግግር ውድቅ በማድረግ ከኦማን ጋር በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት ጉዳይ ላይ ብቻ እየተወያዩ መሆናቸውን ገልጸዋል። በሁለቱ ወገኖች መካከል ያለው የዲፕሎማሲያዊ መረጃ ቅራኔ ሁኔታውን የበለጠ አወዛጋቢ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Pireezidaantichi Donald Tiraamp hariiroon dipilomaasii kan Itoophiyaa waliin jalqabamee jiraachuusaa fi kunis carraa xumuraa akka ta'e ibsaniiru. Haa ta'u malee, mootummaan Iraan dubbii kana haaluun, haasa'a kan godhaa jiran biyya Omaan waliin qofa ta'uu fi innis dhimma nagaa gal-gala Hormuz irratti xiyyeeffatu ibseera. Wal-dhabdeen odeeffannoo kun, haala jiru daran muddamaa taasiseera.

title: Two workers who died in quake-hit Japan mall were sent in to get cash
english: A Japanese company named Habita has apologized after two employees died in a shopping mall explosion caused by a massive earthquake. The workers had been ordered by their supervisor to re-enter the damaged building specifically to retrieve cash. The firm acknowledged that this decision directly violated safety evacuation protocols.
amharic: ሃቢታ የተባለ የጃፓን ኩባንያ በኃይለኛ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ምክንያት በደረሰ የገበያ ማዕከል ፍንዳታ ለሞቱ ሁለት ሠራተኞቹ ይቅርታ ጠይቋል። ሠራተኞቹ ወደ ተጎዳው ሕንፃ እንዲመለሱ የታዘዙት በአለቆቻቸው ትእዛዝ ገንዘብ ለመሰብሰብ ነበር። ኩባንያው ይህ ውሳኔ የደህንነት መመሪያዎችን የጣሰ መሆኑን አምኗል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Jaappan kan 'Habita' jedhamu, hojjettoonni isaa lama kirkira lafaa cimaa booda bakka gabaa tokko keessatti osoo jiranii gubachuu isaaniitiin ergaa gaddaa dabarseera. Hojjettoonni kunneen miidhama irra ga'ee ture keessatti akka deebi'anii maallaqa fudhatan itti gaafatamaan isaanii ajajee ture. Dhaabbatichi gochi kun seera nageenyaa fi bahinsa hatattamaa kan cabse ta'uu isaa amaneera.

title: Death toll from Venezuela earthquakes passes 6,000
english: The Venezuelan government reports that the death toll from two major earthquakes in June has reached 6,125, with over 61,000 people receiving medical care. Officials are facing significant public criticism regarding the slow pace of recovery efforts and the limited removal of debris. Meanwhile, the country is grappling with an estimated $20 billion in damages, leaving the future of the reconstruction process uncertain amid ongoing international sanctions.
amharic: የቬንዙዌላ መንግስት በሰኔ ወር በተከሰቱት ሁለት ከፍተኛ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጦች የሟቾች ቁጥር 6,125 መድረሱን እና ከ61,000 በላይ ሰዎች በሆስፒታል ህክምና እንደተደረገላቸው አስታውቋል። መንግስት በችግሩ ወቅት ያደረገው ምላሽ አዝጋሚ በመሆኑ እና የፍርስራሽ ማስወገጃ ስራዎች በበቂ ሁኔታ ባለመከናወናቸው ከፍተኛ ትችት እየቀረበበት ነው። አገሪቱ ወደ 20 ቢሊዮን ዶላር የሚገመት የንብረት ውድመት የደረሰባት ሲሆን፣ ዓለም አቀፍ ማዕቀቦች ለተሃድሶ ስራው እንቅፋት እንደሆኑ ተጠቁሟል።
oromo: Mootummaan Veenzuweelaa socho'a lafaa cimaa ji'a Waxabajjii keessa biyyattii rukutee kanaan namoonni 6,125 du'uu fi namoonni 61,000 ol ta'an hospitaala akka yaalaman beeksiseera. Hojii gargaarsaa fi firaashii qulqulleessuu irratti hanqina mul'ateef mootummaan hoggantoota isaa irratti komiin cimaan ka'aa jira. Miidhaan socho'a lafaa kanaan ga'e tilmaamaan doolaara biiliyoona 20 ga'a; garuu rakkoo dinagdee fi adabbiiwwan biyyoota alaa jiran irraa kan ka'e, deebisanii dhaabuun biyyattii yaaddoo keessa seeneera.

title: Iran's foreign minister denies talks with US
english: Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesperson has officially rejected claims made by Donald Trump that negotiations between Tehran and Washington were set to begin. The Iranian official clarified that no meetings or direct talks are currently taking place or scheduled. Instead, discussions regarding the Hormuz Strait continue to be handled through mediators from Oman.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር ቃል አቀባይ ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በቴህራን እና በዋሽንግተን መካከል ድርድር ይጀምራል በሚል የተናገሩትን ውድቅ አድርገዋል። በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ምንም አይነት ቀጥተኛ ውይይት እንደሌለ እና ምንም አይነት የመገናኘት እቅድ እንዳልተያዘ ገልጸዋል። በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት ጉዳዮች ላይ የሚደረጉ ውይይቶች ግን በአማን በኩል መካከለኛ አማላጆችን በመጠቀም እንደሚቀጥሉ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Dubbi himaan ministeera dhimma alaa Iraan, Donald Tiraampii mariin Iraanii fi Ameerikaa gidduutti jalqabuu qaba jedhanii dubbatan dhugaa akka hin taane ibsaniiru. Mootummaan Iraan yeroo ammaa kana mariin kallattii tokko illee akka hin jirre fi karoora wal-arguu kan hin qabne ta'uu mirkaneessaniiru. Haaluma kanaan, mariin dhimma Hormuz Strait irratti taasifamu hundi kan geggeeffamaa jiru giddu galeessummaa biyya Omaaniin ta'uu himaniiru.

title: Iranian plan to attack Ukraine canceled after Kyiv apology
english: A senior Iranian official recently revealed that Tehran had prepared a military strike against Ukraine in retaliation for an alleged attack on an Iranian commercial ship. The planned operation was halted only after Ukraine issued an apology for the incident. This decision prevented a direct military escalation between the two nations.
amharic: ከፍተኛ የኢራን ባለስልጣን እንደገለጹት፣ ኢራን በካስፒያን ባህር ላይ ለደረሰ የንግድ መርከብ ጥቃት ምላሽ ለመስጠት በዩክሬን ላይ ጥቃት ለመሰንዘር አቅዳ ነበር። የኢራን ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች ጥቃቱን ለመፈጸም ዝግጅታቸውን አጠናቀው የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ ዩክሬን ይቅርታ መጠየቋን ተከትሎ እቅዱ እንዲሰረዝ ተደርጓል። ይህም በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ሊፈጠር የነበረውን ወታደራዊ ግጭት አስቀርቷል።
oromo: Hoggansi olaanaa Iraan tokko akka ibsetti, Iraan doonii daldalaa ishee kan galaana Kaasphiyaan irratti haleelameef deebii kennuuf jecha Yukreen irratti haleellaa raawwachuuf karoorfattee turte. Humnoonni waraana Iraan qophii isaanii xumuranii kan turan ta'us, Yukreen dhiifama waan gaafatteef haleellaan sun haqeera. Tarkaanfiin kunis walitti bu'iinsa waraanaa lamaan gidduutti uumamuu malu dhaabuu danda'eera.

title: Israel revels in Spain's migrant crisis while embarrassing ally Morocco
english: Israeli officials are publicly mocking Spain following a deadly migration surge at the Ceuta border, reportedly as retaliation for Madrid's criticism of Israel’s actions in Gaza. Reports indicate that Morocco opened its border gates, leading to a humanitarian tragedy where dozens of people, including a professional athlete, lost their lives attempting to reach the Spanish enclave. Experts believe Israel is amplifying this crisis to punish Spain for its diplomatic stance against Israeli military policies.
amharic: የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት በሰኡታ ድንበር ላይ በደረሰው የፍልሰተኞች ቀውስ ሳቢያ ስፔንን በይፋ እያፌዙባት ሲሆን ይህ ድርጊት ማድሪድ በእስራኤል ላይ ለምትሰነዝረው ትችት የበቀል እርምጃ እንደሆነ ይነገራል። ሞሮኮ የድንበር በሮችን መክፈቷን ተከትሎ በደረሰው አሳዛኝ ክስተት አንዲት ስፖርተኛን ጨምሮ በርካታ ሰዎች ህይወታቸውን አጥተዋል። ተንታኞች እንደሚሉት እስራኤል ይህንን ቀውስ የምትጠቀምበት ስፔን የፍልስጤምን ጉዳይ በመደገፏ ለመቅጣት ነው።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Israa'el daangaa Se'utaatti rakkoo godaantotaa muudate fayyadamuun Spaanish irratti qoosachaa kan jiran yoo ta'u, kunis tarkaanfii Spaanish Israa'el irratti qeeqxee fudhatteef haaloo bahuudha jedhameera. Marookoon karra daangaa ishee erga bantee booda balaa mudateen ispoortiiwwan tokko dabalatee namoonni hedduun lubbuu isaanii dhabaniiru. Ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti, Israa'el rakkoo kana kan fayyadamtu Spaanish dhimma Falasxiin irratti qabxii ishee jabeessitee fudhatteef adabuufi.
